SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

We're hiring an Enterprise Platform Engineer to build the foundational systems that make Cursor ready for the world's largest engineering organizations.

Today we have basic organizations, simple IAM primitives, early audit logs, analytics APIs, and admin APIs — but enterprise customers need much more. You will design and build the platform layer that powers organization management, access control, compliance, and administrative tooling across Cursor's product surface. This is a deeply technical IC role focused on building correct, secure, and scalable enterprise infrastructure — not gluing together vendor SDKs.

What you’ll do

  • Build and evolve our organization management system — multi-level org structures, groups, roles, lifecycle, and provisioning via SCIM, so admins can manage thousands of seats without friction.

  • Design and implement RBAC with fine-grained roles, permissions, and resource scopes that cover organizations, teams, agents, and other resources — balancing security with developer ergonomics.

  • Extend enterprise settings and policies — org-wide defaults, security policies (allowed models, MCPs, Tools, network restrictions), and configuration inheritance across different products.

  • Deepen our audit logging infrastructure — comprehensive, queryable, tamper-evident audit trails that satisfy customer-specific compliance requirements.

  • Build admin APIs and internal tooling that enterprise admins, customer success, and sales engineering depend on to manage organizations, investigate access issues, and onboard large accounts.

  • Ship compliance features end-to-end — SSO enforcement, session management, allowlisting, data analytics, and the controls that procurement and security teams require before signing.

  • Partner with product, security, and infrastructure teams to define enterprise platform abstractions that scale across the product without slowing down feature development.

  • You will own organization management, RBAC and authorization, enterprise settings and policies, audit logs, admin APIs, and compliance-related platform features. You will be a technical authority on how Cursor models identity, access, and governance for enterprise customers.

  • You will not own SSO/IdP integration at the protocol level (we use WorkOS) or billing and payments.

  • Security and correctness are part of the job, but the goal is to build systems with enough rigor and observability that enterprise operations are boring — not to manually triage every access control edge case.

You may be a fit if

  • You've built multi-tenant organization or IAM systems in production and have opinions on permission models, role inheritance, and policy evaluation.

  • You've shipped RBAC or ABAC systems and understand the tradeoffs between flexibility and complexity.

  • You deeply about correctness in authorization and understand why "fail closed" matters.

  • You can hold the tension between "ship enterprise features fast" and "do not create security gaps or break existing access patterns."

  • You feel comfortable shipping features end-to-end — from database schema and API design to admin UI and documentation.

#LI-DNI

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

We’re hiring a Senior HR Business Partner to support our rapidly scaling Go-to-Market organization. This person will partner closely with senior leaders across Sales, Marketing, Business Operations, and Recruiting to help build high-performing, durable teams in a fast-moving environment.

This is not a traditional HRBP role. You’ll operate as a strategic thought partner and hands-on builder in a high-talent-density company where expectations are high and the pace is fast. We’re looking for someone who combines strong business judgment, operational excellence, and a bias for action — someone willing to do whatever is needed to help the business scale effectively.

You’ll work directly with leaders on organizational effectiveness, performance, talent strategy, and leadership quality while helping define what great People partnership looks like at Cursor.

 

What You’ll Do

Partner Closely with GTM Leadership

  • Act as a trusted advisor to leaders across Sales, Marketing, Business Operations, and Recruiting

  • Coach managers and leaders on performance, feedback, team health, organizational changes, and leadership effectiveness

  • Support high-stakes decision-making and help leaders navigate rapid growth and ambiguity

  • Raise the bar on accountability, talent density, and leadership quality across the organization

Drive Org Design and Talent Strategy

  • Partner on org design, headcount planning, team structure, leveling, and mobility

  • Help leaders build scalable, high-performing teams with clear ownership and accountability

  • Identify organizational gaps and proactively solve for talent, structure, and execution challenges

  • Support thoughtful scaling without introducing unnecessary process or complexity

Own Performance and Employee Experience

  • Drive and operationalize performance management, calibrations, promotions, onboarding, engagement, and development programs

  • Navigate employee relations and sensitive situations with strong judgment, empathy, and pragmatism

  • Ensure high standards are upheld consistently while maintaining a strong employee experience

  • Help build lightweight, high-quality systems that scale with the business

Build and Scale the Function

  • Partner cross-functionally with Recruiting, Compensation, Legal, Finance, and People Ops

  • Build People infrastructure and operating rhythms from the ground up

  • Bring structure, urgency, and follow-through to a fast-moving environment

  • Operate with high ownership and jump into tactical work when needed

 

What We’re Looking For

  • 8–15+ years of experience in HRBP, People Partner, or related leadership roles supporting high-growth GTM organizations

  • Strong expertise in organizational design, performance management, leadership coaching, and talent strategy

  • Excellent judgment and ability to navigate complex, high-stakes situations

  • Comfortable operating with ambiguity and minimal structure

  • Pragmatic, direct, highly execution-oriented, and deeply collaborative

  • Ability to influence senior leaders through credibility and partnership, not process

You Might Be a Fit If You

  • View HR as a core business function, not a support function

  • Care deeply about leadership quality, accountability, and talent density

  • Prefer simple, high-quality systems over heavy process

  • Thrive in fast-moving, high-expectation environments

  • Enjoy building from first principles and operating close to the business

Location

This role is based in New York City (SoHo) with an expectation of domestic and international travel as needed.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FIELD ENGINEER, LIFE SCIENCES

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers across Life Sciences. You'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI for the scientific organizations shortening the path from lab to market: helping programmers, researchers, scientists, and commercial teams evaluate SpaceXSI, running proofs of concept, and making sure they see the full value of agentic coding in their real workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering as a deal partner, not a demo resource. You'll scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor across the stakeholders that matter in Life Sciences: engineering leaders, architects, developers, scientific computing, R&D, and commercial IT.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with AEs to own technical discovery, demos, POCs, and expansion with technical validation; build trusted relationships across engineering, scientific computing, R&D, and commercial IT

  • Go deep in research-heavy and regulated environments: developer workflows, AI tooling, complex setups

  • Help customers connect SpaceXSI to outcomes that matter: faster R&D cycles and a shorter path from lab to market

  • Deliver technical presentations, whiteboards, and workshops for scientific and commercial audiences

  • Act as the customer's technical advocate internally with Product and Engineering; partner with post-sales to hand off cleanly and set up onboarding for success

  • Stay sharp on SpaceXSI and the competitive landscape so you can go toe to toe in the room

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs and scientific leaders

  • Understand the SDLC and can connect technical detail to business and scientific impact

  • Hands-on technical fluency (not full-time eng): workflows, AI tooling, complex environments

  • Deal-partner instinct: co-own with AEs and navigate complex stakeholder maps

  • Customer-obsessed and can translate technical detail into why it matters for the organization

  • Excited by Life Sciences and comfortable learning regulated / research-heavy orgs fast

  • Motivated by putting AI in the hands of people accelerating benefits for humanity

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (United States)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,500 - $224,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $235,000 - $320,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the Role

As a Software Engineer on the Model Routing & Inference team at SpaceXAI, you'll build the inference platform that powers every AI interaction in the product.

This team owns the full inference path: making Cursor's AI faster, more reliable, and more cost-effective at a scale few teams in the world get to operate at. Every agent session, every tab completion, and every chat message flows through your stack.

Example projects include...

  • Building and evolving our inference gateway, a single abstraction over every provider's API semantics, so model onboarding becomes a config change.

  • Designing intelligent cross-provider failover so no single provider outage causes user-visible degradation.

  • Designing routing backpressure and admission control so traffic spikes don't cascade into providers.

You may be a fit if

  • You have deep experience building high-throughput, low-latency distributed systems, especially in inference serving, traffic routing, or real-time data pipelines.

  • You're comfortable reasoning about cost/performance tradeoffs at scale (GPU utilization, provider economics, capacity planning).

  • You have strong software engineering fundamentals and enjoy shipping production systems that handle millions of requests.

  • You make good calls in the gray area: weighing reliability, cost, latency, and user experience when there isn't a single "right" answer.

Applying

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

As a Commercial Account Executive at Cursor, you'll drive revenue growth by building strategic relationships with customers and helping them realize the full potential of Cursor for their development teams. You'll cover the full spectrum, from high velocity fast-growing startups to more complex Mid-Market deals, adapting your playbook to each.

You'll work closely with engineering organizations to understand their development workflows, demonstrate how Cursor transforms developer productivity, and guide them through evaluation, implementation, and expansion. This role combines technical fluency with sales expertise to help companies reimagine how software gets built with AI.

What you'll do

  • Win new business and drive revenue for Cursor. Find your way to the right people at prospective customers, educate them about AI-powered development, and help them succeed. You'll own the full sales cycle, from first call to close

  • Become a trusted product expert; guide prospects through trials, evaluations, and rollouts

  • Build and manage a healthy high velocity pipeline, meeting and exceeding quarterly targets

  • Lead multi-threaded sales cycles across Engineering, Product, Security, Procurement, and Legal

  • Develop executive relationships and day-to-day champions within each account

  • Quantify value with clear ROI cases tied to developer productivity and AI adoption

  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies; analyze market trends and translate high-level plans into targeted activities and campaigns

  • Be the voice of the customer and influence the roadmap with actionable feedback

  • Continuously refine the sales methodology by incorporating learnings into playbooks, templates, and best practices

You may be a fit if

  • You have 3+ years of closing experience in tech sales, ideally selling developer tools, technical SaaS, or emerging technologies

  • You have a consistent track record of landing new logos and exceeding quota and managing a high velocity of deals

  • You're a true hunter - you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up, rather than relying on inbound demand

  • You're comfortable navigating complex sales cycles and selling to technical stakeholders, from ICs to CTOs

  • You bring an analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative, tactical follow-through to advance opportunities

  • You have a knack for bringing order to chaos and a genuine "roll up your sleeves" mentality

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer's engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer's auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You've owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You've built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Australia or Singapore or Japan office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$235,000 - $320,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

GTM APPLICATIONS ENGINEER

SpaceXSI's go-to-market org is growing fast, and the software that runs it has to keep up. GTM Apps sits inside Revenue Operations and builds the internal products our Sales, Customer Success, Field Engineering, and RevOps teams use every day for account intelligence, forecasting, pricing, and more. We also enable other teams to build apps for themselves via enablement and maintaining shared infrastructure. As a GTM Applications Engineer, you'll own product surfaces end-to-end by talking to users, shipping full-stack applications, keeping production apps healthy, and raising the bar on reliability and UX.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, and ship full-stack features for GTM Apps (TypeScript / Next.js and our shared internal stack), from idea through production

  • Enable our world-class sales team to exceed their ambitious goals with world-class software; own a product surface and drive its roadmap (e.g. account intelligence, pricing, forecasting, our internal data API, etc)

  • Partner closely with RevOps, Data Engineering, and field teams to turn messy operational processes into durable software

  • Improve the reliability, performance, and user experience for critical software our GTM teams depend on for daily work

  • Build and maintain shared infrastructure other GTM builders can use (e.g. APIs, UI libraries, authentication frameworks, etc)

  • Triage and fix issues in our app suite and use that feedback as an input signal for your roadmap; use AI tooling aggressively in your own workflow and, where it helps users, in the products you ship

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, math, or scientific discipline; OR 2+ years of professional experience building software in lieu of a degree

  • Experience in full stack development

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Programming experience in Python, C#.NET, Go, Scala, Java, or similar object-oriented language

  • 1+ years of rigorous experience building single page web applications

  • Experience with version control, continuous integration, and continuous delivery concepts

  • Expertise in designing software systems

  • Deep understanding of testing, continuous integration, build, deployment & monitoring

  • Expertise in profiling and improving application performance

  • Experience with build systems (Make, Bazel/Pants/Buck, Gradle) and package management tools (pip, npm)

  • Experience with UNIX-like operating systems and tools like Terraform, Ansible, Puppet for managing them

  • Experience working with in-stream data processing using Apache Kafka, RabbitMQ, ActiveMQ, or similar technologies

  • Production experience with Docker and Kubernetes

  • Front-end experience in Angular, React, or similar JavaScript framework

  • Database experience with PostgreSQL, SQL Server, or similar database technologies

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco or New York office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$240,000 - $325,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT, CENTRAL EUROPE

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the Role

As a Recruiting Coordinator, you'll be the person who makes candidates feel genuinely welcomed through every interaction, and the person our hiring teams rely on to keep everything running like clockwork. You'll be part scheduling tetris wizard, part host, and part operations builder.

This is an opportunity to be part of building something from the ground up. The team you help hire today will shape what SpaceXSI becomes. This role is for you if you love the satisfaction of getting things done quickly, thrive in environments that are fluid and constantly evolving, obsess over learning new things, and enjoy meeting and interacting with new people.

Responsibilities

  • Own the full scheduling experience including interview coordination so every candidate and interviewer shows up informed, prepared, and on time.

  • Host candidates onsite and create a candidate experience that's warm, human, and memorable.

  • Keep candidates and hiring teams in the loop throughout the process with timely, warm, and clear communication.

  • Partner closely with recruiters, interviewers, and hiring managers to anticipate needs, solve problems in real time, and keep things moving.

  • Keep our Applicant Tracking System accurate and up to date so nothing falls through the cracks.

  • Identify and execute on opportunities to improve how we operate.

Basic Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree.

Preferred Skills or Qualifications

  • Experience coordinating high-volume schedules or logistics through internships, campus leadership or early-career roles in recruiting, people operations, executive or administrative support, or hospitality and events.

  • Excellent organizational, project management, and multitasking abilities.

  • Team player with a high sense of urgency.

  • Experience managing many concurrent requests while maintaining accuracy.

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills.

  • Experience delivering a high-quality experience to candidates, clients or guests.

  • Comfortable handling confidential information with discretion.

  • Experience with Ashby, Greenhouse or similar Applicant Tracking System.

Additional Requirements

  • This role is based at our San Francisco office and is fully in-office, 5 days per week.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the Role

We're hiring a Software Engineer for our User Operations team to own and build our product quality infrastructure and tooling — the systems that capture, triage, route, and acts on customer and product feedback at scale. You'll work on everything from intelligent bug reporting pipelines to software that captures customer feedback at scale to systems that give our business real-time visibility into our strongest Voice of the Customer signals.

This is an internal-facing role with direct impact on product quality. You'll be building the systems that close the loop between what customers experience and what gets built — helping us catch problems before our users do, and ensuring the right signal reaches the right people, fast. If building an AI-native, first-of-its-kind Voice of the Customer program from the ground up excites you, this role is for you.

What you'll do

  • Develop AI-powered systems that synthesize customer signal at scale — separating noise from what matters, routing feedback to the right teams, and surfacing the voice of the customer in ways that actually shape product decisions.

  • Build dashboards and data pipelines that give engineering and product leaders real-time visibility into bug volume, quality trends, and where their domains stand — by product area, severity, and over time.

  • Build intelligent bug intake and triage systems — moving from manual, inconsistent prioritization to agentic pipelines that produce well-written, well-prioritized bug reports at scale.

  • Build integrations across our tooling ecosystem (ticketing systems, payment processes, CRM, data warehouse, etc.) to create seamless workflows.

  • Partner with domain specialists and support engineers to identify pain points and ship solutions quickly — you're building for an internal team that will tell you exactly what's broken.

You may be a fit if

  • Experience working cross-functionally to deliver highly impactful, technical projects and systems

  • Experience building internal tools, developer platforms, or operations infrastructure.

  • Strong full-stack engineering skills — you're comfortable owning projects from database to UI.

  • Experience with data pipelines, ETL processes, and analytics tooling.

  • Deep product knowledge of Cursor and AI-assisted development workflows.

  • Experience integrating with third-party platforms (ticketing systems, payment processors, CRMs).

  • Strong sense of ownership and a bias for action — you ship fast and iterate based on feedback.

  • Self-starter with curiosity, creativity, and a distaste for manual toil.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - WESTERN EUROPE

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FIELD ENGINEER - ASEAN

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI in the field, helping customers evaluate SpaceXSI, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer-facing role where you'll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements; build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor

  • Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration

  • Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands-on workshops tailored to customer needs

  • Act as the customer's technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering

  • Collaborate with post-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively

  • Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs

  • A deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges

  • Hands-on technical ability, and while you don't need to be a full-time engineer, you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments

  • Customer-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact

  • Thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (Singapore)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING

We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from SpaceXSI and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade SpaceXSI workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped. We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close, partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written

  • Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI; sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it; drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements; serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite

  • Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teams. Translate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions

  • Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions; Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest

  • Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time; lead, develop, and scale a team of 6-8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects; hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production

  • Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field, scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex; build and scale the partner FDE track, train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience directly managing a team of engineers who build and ship production software

  • Professional software development experience in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript

  • Experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows in production environments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Leadership experience in forward deployed engineering, data science, machine learning engineering or software engineers

  • Debugging model failures in production AI systems

  • Scoping six- and seven-figure technical engagements with Sales and presenting them to C-suite and engineering leadership buyers

  • Enabling GSI or consulting partners to deliver technical engagements

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco or New York or Austin office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$350,000 - $400,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SALES DEVELOPMENT LEADER, APJ

SpaceXSI is hiring a Sales Development Leader, APJ to build and lead our Sales Development organization across Asia Pacific from our Sydney office. You'll hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Account Associates who generate pipeline and accelerate customer adoption across the region. Rather than relying on cold outreach alone, the team partners with Growth, Marketing, RevOps, and Sales to engage customers at the right moment with personalized outreach informed by product usage, PLG signals, and automation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Account Associates supporting the APJ business; lead the team's day-to-day execution against pipeline generation goals, activity metrics, and conversion targets

  • Partner with Growth, RevOps, Marketing, and Sales to execute signal-based outbound programs leveraging product usage, PLG insights, events, and other buying signals

  • Help define and refine regional sales development playbooks that combine modern automation with highly personalized customer engagement; coach Account Associates on prospecting, discovery, qualification, messaging, and customer engagement to consistently improve pipeline quality

  • Establish a strong operating cadence through regular pipeline reviews, one-on-ones, performance coaching, team meetings, and career development

  • Monitor team performance, identify trends, and use data to continuously improve productivity, conversion rates, and execution; collaborate closely with Commercial and Enterprise Sales leaders to ensure high-quality pipeline generation and seamless opportunity handoffs

  • Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning; develop future sales talent by creating clear career pathways into Account Executive and other GTM roles across SpaceXSI

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, including experience leading frontline Sales Development or SDR teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience hiring, coaching, and developing SDRs or Account Associates in a technology company

  • Experience building outbound pipeline generation through prospecting, automation, and data-driven experimentation

  • Experience managing team performance through metrics, coaching, and structured operating cadences

  • Experience partnering with Marketing, Growth, RevOps, and Sales to improve pipeline generation and conversion

  • Experience developing sales team members into Account Executive or other GTM roles

  • Experience with AI products, developer tools, growth automation platforms, or PLG motions, including helping teams engage technical buyers

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role based in our Sydney, Australia office

  • Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across Japan, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue; run a disciplined, full-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close

  • Build and execute account strategies that connect SpaceXSI's capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams

  • Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, and your own network; partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly

  • Experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in Japan

  • Comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - JAPAN

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE - COMMERCIAL (SINGAPORE)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

As a founding member of our Startup Events and Community team, you'll be the growth engine behind Cursor for Startups, responsible for turning our startup strategy into high-impact programs that win the right early-stage companies, help founders get deeper value from Cursor, and turn our strongest founder-users into advocates.

This is a builder role for someone who's energized by the founder and startup community. We're building a focused program across top Seed–Series B startups, reaching them directly and through VC and accelerator ecosystems. You'll design the strategy for the events, community moments, and hackathons that create genuine advocacy and deeper product usage and make decisions about where we should show up and where we shouldn’t. If you want to be in and create the rooms with founders building the future, this is the role for you.

This role is based in our San Francisco office and requires working in-office.

What You'll Do

Program Architecture & Segment Ownership

  • Design the startup events playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for the startup segment, focused on landing and growing usage within top Seed–Series B companies across YC and the broader ecosystem.

  • Own the founder funnel and footprint: Deploy a mix of founder events, hackathons, executive/founder roundtables, and community activations to acquire the right startups and drive them toward meaningful success using Cursor.

  • Build ecosystem relationships: Partner with VCs, accelerators, and other startup partners to reach their portfolio founders through growth programs, content, and co-hosted moments. Help identify which partners are worth going deep with.

  • Creativity: Fearlessly break the standard playbook by avoiding generic engagement formats - find out how founders actually build and gather and design around that.

  • Founder advocacy: Surface and amplify founder/customer stories worth telling, and feature them in our events. Become a trusted partner and peer to the founders using Cursor.

Measurement & Operational Excellence

  • Event orchestration: Own programs end to end, from ideation and promotion toonsite experience and follow-up. Keep it scrappy and high-signal; obsess over the details that make founders feel Cursor cares about them early.

  • Data-driven iteration: Track spend against real outcomes (activation, usage, retention, advocacy), not vanity metrics. Manage your budget toward the highest-impact investments and deprioritize what isn't working.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • GTM partnership: Work closely with the Events, Growth, PMM, and Field Engineering teams. Bring FEs into events to help founders build real automations, align on which startups show strong usage signals, and flag when a company is genuinely ready for an Enterprise conversation.

  • Product and marketing partnership: Be the "eyes and ears" of the founder community. Feed real-time insights on messaging resonance, credits/billing confusion, feature awareness, and competitive shifts back to Product and Marketing.

What You’ll Bring

  • Experience in or with startups: You have 4–7+ years in field, community, event, growth, or revenue marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or developer tools. You understand founders and early-stage engineering teams, and how they buy, build, and talk to each other.

  • Builder mindset: You're a self-starter who can build a program from scratch and then obsessively optimize it based on data.

  • Community obsession: You genuinely like being around founders and builders, and you know the difference between a program that feels authentic to that community and one that feels like a vendor hard sell.

  • Storytelling: Your communication is sharp, credible, and founder-native. You can hold your own in a room full of technical founders.

Role Specifics

  • Field presence: Ability to travel (~20%) to host events, support hackathons, and connect with founders in-region.

  • Event craft: Experience producing standout events, from intimate founder dinners to high-energy hackathons, that people actually want to attend.

  • Location: In-office role based out of our San Francisco office.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

The Data team at SpaceXSI is a small team that works across the company to inform business and product decisions, and we’re hiring the first member of our team to focus fully on marketing. Performance Marketing at SpaceXSI drives scaled acquisition across 10+ channels for Grok, Grok Bot, and our full portfolio of AI products, across consumer, SMB, startup, and enterprise audiences.

This role will sit in the central Data team and partner directly with Marketing leadership to own the measurement and analysis of performance marketing, growth marketing programs, and overall marketing measurement. You'll use your expertise to inform where the next dollar goes as we scale paid acquisition, while building the foundations of a world class marketing data team. Your job is to help us understand the impact of our activities and what we should do next.

What you'll do

  • Build and own the measurement layer for performance marketing: economics and performance by channel, campaign, audience, geo, and creative, across both PLG and Sales-Led revenue lines

  • Design incrementality tests (geo, audience, and conversion lift) with channel owners, and use the results to move budget and calibrate attribution, not just to fill a slide

  • Stand up and maintain our media-mix model, and pair it with test results to answer the big allocation questions: which channels to scale, which to cut, and where we're hitting saturation

  • Own the quality of the predictive LTV signal we send to Meta, Google, and the other networks: validate it against realized revenue, catch drift and breakage early, and partner with Data and Engineering to improve it

  • Keep pipeline source and campaign attribution separate and clean, so self-reported source, promo codes, click-based attribution, and CRM pipeline each answer their own question without double counting revenue

You may be a fit if

  • You have 7+ years of experience in marketing analytics, marketing science, or data science supporting paid acquisition

  • You have strong SQL and python skills and are comfortable building both data pipelines and predictive models

  • You've run hold-out or incrementality tests and worked with MMM and attribution models in production, and you know the limitations of each

  • You understand how ad platforms report, optimize, and ingest conversion signals, and you don't take platform-reported numbers at face value

  • You communicate clearly with channel managers, Finance, and leadership, and you're honest about what the data does and doesn't support

  • You're self-directed, comfortable owning ambiguous problems end to end

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering.

The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer’s auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer’s repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar. Either way, you measure what matters, leave the customer able to operate it, and bring the pattern back as another use case for SpaceXSI.

This is not a demo role. You own the work end to end, from the first discovery call through launch, iteration, and post-launch support, and you are responsible for systems that work in the real world.

What you’ll do

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

You may be a fit if

  • Required

    • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

    • You write and review production code (Python, JavaScript/TypeScript; other languages welcome)

    • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

    • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production, and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

    • You’ve handled production reliability: metrics, alerts, safe rollouts, incident response

    • You build end to end: frontend, backend, infra, and prompt iteration

    • You thrive in ambiguity and don’t need a complete spec before you start building

    • You can talk to working engineers and to a VP

    Nice to have

    • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

    • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

    • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED STRATEGIST

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Strategist to own our most strategic customer engagements—from initial workshop through delivery. Working in a pod with 1–2 FDEs, you'll partner with executive sponsors to identify high-value use cases, scope tightly focused projects, and stay accountable for outcomes. You'll remain hands-on at the configuration layer while translating technical builds into measurable business results and driving adoption—all while flywheeling valuable feedback into our product offerings.
This role requires technical credibility in agentic coding and LLMs, executive presence to earn boardroom trust, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with executive sponsors to translate ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed projects with clear ROI, validating technical feasibility through discovery and architecture reviews.

  • Own the configuration layer of the technical build—workflows, integrations, and platform tooling—partnering with FDEs on deeper production work while monitoring feasibility and adjusting scope as needed.

  • Serve as the primary executive point of contact, selling the vision and plan to C-suite stakeholders and translating between business outcomes and technical implementation.

  • Identify expansion opportunities during delivery and escalate product gaps and customer pain to Product and Engineering to shape the roadmap.

  • Build reusable playbooks that strengthen the broader FDE organization over time.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 6+ years in Solutions Architecture, Deployment Strategy, technical consulting, or Engagement Manager roles owning scoping and delivery with technical teams on AI-production workflows.

  • Strong understanding of agentic coding and LLMs in production: how they behave, where they fail, and what resilient workflows look like.

  • Shipped AI-native workflows past the prototype stage and can distinguish real production constraints from nice-to-haves.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on comfort with SpaceXSI workflows, integrations, and platform config; able to read Python/JS-TS to partner effectively with FDEs.

  • Domain depth in FSI, insurance, telecom, high-tech, healthcare/life sciences, or semiconductor.

  • Experience building out agentic systems and model training.

  • Ex-founder experience is a strong plus

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$215,000 - $300,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
