We are hiring a Sales Development Leader, APJ to build and lead SpaceXAI’s Sales Development organization across Asia Pacific. Based in our Singapore office, this is a frontline leadership role responsible for hiring, coaching, and developing a high-performing team of Account Associates that generate pipeline and accelerate customer adoption across the region.

This isn’t a traditional SDR organization focused solely on cold outreach. Our Sales Development team partners closely with Growth, Marketing, RevOps, and Sales to identify buying signals, engage customers at the right moment, and create highly personalized outreach informed by product usage, PLG signals, and creative automation. You’ll help your team balance modern, signal-based engagement with disciplined outbound prospecting to consistently create new opportunities across commercial and enterprise accounts.

You’ll be responsible for building a strong team culture, driving execution against pipeline goals, coaching early-career talent, and continuously improving how SpaceXAI engages prospective customers across APJ. This role is ideal for a hands-on sales leader who enjoys coaching people, experimenting with new approaches, and building scalable operating rhythms in a fast-growing company.

 

This is a full-time, in-office leadership role based in our Singapore office.

 

What You’ll Do

  • Hire, onboard, coach, and develop a high-performing team of Account Associates supporting the APJ business.

  • Lead the team’s day-to-day execution against pipeline generation goals, activity metrics, and conversion targets.

  • Partner with Growth, RevOps, Marketing, and Sales to execute signal-based outbound programs leveraging product usage, PLG insights, events, and other buying signals.

  • Help define and refine regional sales development playbooks that combine modern automation with highly personalized customer engagement.

  • Coach Account Associates on prospecting, discovery, qualification, messaging, and customer engagement to consistently improve pipeline quality.

  • Establish a strong operating cadence through regular pipeline reviews, one-on-ones, performance coaching, team meetings, and career development.

  • Monitor team performance, identify trends, and use data to continuously improve productivity, conversion rates, and execution.

  • Collaborate closely with Commercial and Enterprise Sales leaders to ensure high-quality pipeline generation and seamless opportunity handoffs.

  • Foster a culture of curiosity, experimentation, accountability, and continuous learning.

  • Develop future sales talent by creating clear career pathways into Account Executive and other GTM roles across SpaceXAI.

     

What We’re Looking For

  • 5+ years of SaaS sales experience, including experience leading frontline Sales Development or SDR teams.

  • Proven success hiring, coaching, and developing high-performing SDRs or Account Associates in a fast-paced technology company.

  • Experience building predictable outbound pipeline generation through a combination of prospecting, automation, and data-driven experimentation.

  • Strong operational discipline with experience managing team performance through metrics, coaching, and structured operating cadences.

  • Experience partnering cross-functionally with Marketing, Growth, RevOps, and Sales to improve pipeline generation and conversion.

  • Passion for coaching and developing early-career sales talent into successful GTM professionals.

  • Curiosity about AI, developer tools, or technical products, with the ability to help teams engage technical buyers effectively.

  • Comfortable operating in a high-growth, fast-changing environment where experimentation and continuous improvement are expected.

  • Excellent communication, coaching, and leadership skills with a collaborative, builder’s mindset.

  • Experience with AI products, growth automation platforms, PLG motions, or developer-focused technology is a plus.

  • Scope

    • Partner with customer executive sponsors to scope FDE projects — translating ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI

    • Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints to validate that every engagement is technically feasible

    Deliver

    • Work side by side with the FDE on the technical build — you own the configuration layer including workflows, settings, integrations, and platform tooling that don't require heavy custom code while the FDE owns the deeper production builds

    • Own technical enablement and adoption: run hands-on training, build playbooks and reference workflows, and coach the customer's team until they're self-sufficient. Adoption is measured by what their users do without you in the room

    • Monitor technical feasibility throughout delivery, adjusting scope with the sponsor when constraints emerge rather than letting engagements drift

    • Translate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions — for the sponsor and for the build team

  • You understand agentic coding and LLMs well enough to hold your own with senior eng: how they behave in production, where they fail, and what a resilient workflow looks like (you don't need to be the person writing the production code)

  • You're comfortable hands-on with Cursor workflows, integrations, and platform config, and can read enough Python / JS-TS to partner with an FDE

  • You've shipped AI-native workflows past the prototype stage and can tell a real production constraint from a nice-to-have

  • You can walk into an unfamiliar enterprise eng org, find the highest-leverage intervention fast, and scope something that delivers concrete value in weeks, not quarters

  • Domain depth in FSI, insurance, telecom, high-tech, healthcare/life sciences, or semiconductor is a strong plus

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PRODUCT EDUCATION ENGINEER

SpaceXSI ships fast: new models, new agentic capabilities, and new workflows every week. The gap between what our product can do and what developers know how to build with it grows with every release. As a Product Education Engineer, you'll close that gap through hands-on labs, workshops, and tutorials, using our product as part of your own development process.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build our technical learning library, including code walkthroughs, tutorials, labs, workshops, reference implementations, and instructor-led training

  • Lead large-format workshops, technical deep dives, and hands-on enablement sessions that help engineering organizations adopt AI coding tools and drive measurable outcomes

  • Partner with Product, Engineering, DevRel, and Go-to-Market ahead of major launches so new capabilities ship with clear educational framing, practical examples, and adoption paths on day one

  • Get Field Engineers, AI Deployment Managers, and Solutions Architects up to speed quickly on new capabilities

  • Design learning experiences for both developers and non-technical users (e.g. engineering leaders evaluating rollout, PMs pairing with agents)

  • Measure what works, tracking adoption and fluency gains rather than completion rates, and share insights with Product and Engineering on where developers get stuck

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Consulting, or software engineering at a developer tools or platform company

  • Experience delivering technical training, workshops, or enablement sessions to engineering audiences

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on experience across the software development lifecycle, with an understanding of how modern engineering organizations build software

  • Daily use of AI coding tools, with customized personal development workflows

  • Experience building demo environments, sample repos, content-freshness automation, or self-service enablement tooling

  • Experience designing technical curriculum or learning programs for both developer and non-technical audiences

  • Experience presenting complex technical concepts to engineering leaders and executives to support decisions on tool adoption

  • Experience with interactive or AI-native learning formats such as in-product learning, hands-on labs, or live teaching

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$130,000 - $210,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

About the Role

Security GRC Engineers design, implement, and scale our governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) program. You'll lead automation of compliance workflows, build self-serve tools to enable GTM teams, and ensure our products and infrastructure meet the highest security standards. This role blends technical implementation with strategic program development, directly shaping how we build trust with customers.

You may be a fit if

  • You have experience with GRC frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, and AIUC-1.

  • You're comfortable tracing an external claim back to how the product and infrastructure are actually configured — you use coding agents and curiosity to confirm that what we say is what we do, flag issues that affect the security and AI governance program, and drive them to the right outcome.

  • You have strong cross-functional collaboration skills, especially with Engineering, Legal, GTM, Trust & Safety, auditors, and regulators.

Sample projects include

  • Automate evidence gathering and continuous control testing.

  • Own the relationship with audit firms and customers — you're the person who explains the security and AI governance program and earns their trust in it.

  • Conduct security compliance reviews for new products, features, and vendors.

  • Support Legal in contract negotiations with timely, accurate guidance on security and AI governance terms.

  • Support incident response communications — draft and review customer-facing updates during security incidents.

  • Build self-serve documentation and tools to answer customer security and AI governance inquiries.

  • Maintain corporate security policies.

Applying

If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2–3 short technicals. After that, we'll schedule an onsite at our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team.

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

We're building a Forward Deployed Engineering team to close the gap between the value our enterprise customers expect from Cursor and the value they're actually getting. FDEs don't advise, they embed directly with customer engineering teams, build production-grade Cursor workflows, and transfer the habits and culture that compound long after the engagement ends. The measure of success is what's different at day 30, not what got shipped.

We're looking for a Regional Director, Forward Deployed Engineering to lead and help scale this team. You'll manage a growing team of FDEs working across our most strategic enterprise accounts, own what makes a world-class FDE engagement, and stay close enough to the work to escalate, coach, and course-correct in real time. You will serve as the primary point of contact for customers, owning both project delivery and the day-to-day relationship, while also identifying and scoping new opportunities. You'll also build our partner FDE track — training and enabling GSI and consulting partners who extend this motion at scale.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who combines deep technical credibility, strong people management, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating. This role will be based in all 3 cities: Bengaluru, Mumbai and New Delhi.

What you’ll do

  • Sell

    • Own the full arc from technical discovery to executive close — partnering with Sales and Account teams to qualify opportunities, leading architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints, and scoping engagements with enough precision to de-risk delivery before a line of code is written

    • Build and present proposals that translate ambiguous customer problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI

    • Sell the vision and the plan to C-suite stakeholders who need to believe in both the outcome and the team delivering it

    • Drive deal strategy on strategic accounts; your technical credibility is a direct lever on close rates for six- and seven-figure engagements

    Deliver

    • Serve as executive technical sponsor on your region's highest-priority engagements and manage stakeholder relationships from IC engineers to C-suite

    • Ensure delivery quality across your team's projects: appropriate scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teamsTranslate between business outcomes and technical implementation in both directions

    • Identify and escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions

    • Manage active engagements: escalate on complex builds, coach FDEs on scoping and delivery decisions, and step in directly on accounts where the stakes are highest

    • Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

    Manage People

    • Lead, develop, and scale a team of 6–8 Forward Deployed Engineers working strategic FDE projects

    • Hire top-tier FDE talent; set clear expectations, technical performance standards, and career growth paths for a team where "excellent" means actually shipping in production

    • Coach FDEs through the hardest problems in the field — scoping under deal pressure, building alongside senior technical stakeholders, and knowing when to protect scope vs. when to flex

    • Build and scale the partner FDE track — train, enable, and hold the quality bar for GSI and consulting partners who carry the FDE motion forward at volume

You may be a fit if

  • You have 8+ years of experience leading technical teams that build and ship in production — Forward Deployed Engineering, Solutions Engineering, or a similar function where writing and reviewing code is part of the job

  • You have experience with software development and coding in Python, Javascript/Typescript

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows in production, not just prototypes, and have debugged real-world model failures

  • You can diagnose a complex enterprise engineering environment quickly, identify the highest-leverage intervention, and scope a meaningful engagement

  • You've built and scaled IC-level technical teams and know what excellence looks like in the field: sharp scoping, clean delivery, and knowledge that stays at the customer long after the engagement closes

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role

We're looking for a Forward Deployed Strategist to own our most strategic customer engagements - from first workshop through delivery. You'll sit with executive sponsors, surface the highest-value use cases, turn them into tightly scoped projects, then stay accountable for the outcome, working with the FDE.

You'll typically work in a pod of one Strategist and 1-2 FDEs. You own the executive relationship and the shape of delivery; the FDE embeds with the customer's team and owns the deeper production builds. You'll stay hands-on at the configuration layer week to week, including workflows, integrations, and platform tooling, partnering with the FDE where the build is most complex. You will translate technical build into business outcomes and own the adoption of the build.

This is for someone who combines technical credibility in agentic coding and LLMs with the executive presence to earn trust in the boardroom, and the judgment to keep engagements scoped tight, delivered fast, and worth repeating.

What you’ll do

  • Scope

    • Partner with customer executive sponsors to scope FDE projects — translating ambiguous business problems into concrete, time-boxed deliverables with clear ROI

    • Lead technical discovery and architecture reviews, surfacing integration complexity and infrastructure constraints to validate that every engagement is technically feasible

    Deliver

    • Work side by side with the FDE on the technical build — you own the configuration layer including workflows, settings, integrations, and platform tooling that don't require heavy custom code while the FDE owns the deeper production builds

    • Own technical enablement and adoption: run hands-on training, build playbooks and reference workflows, and coach the customer's team until they're self-sufficient. Adoption is measured by what their users do without you in the room

    • Monitor technical feasibility throughout delivery, adjusting scope with the sponsor when constraints emerge rather than letting engagements drift

    • Identify and scope expansion opportunities as they surface during delivery, in partnership with the account team

    • Escalate product gaps, integration friction, and recurring customer pain back to Product and Engineering with enough specificity to drive roadmap decisions

    • Build reusable playbooks that make the broader FDE org more capable over time

    Own the executive relationship

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOFTWARE ENGINEER, ML PLATFORM

As a Software Engineer on ML Platform at SpaceXSI, you'll build the infrastructure that turns real product usage into better models, and keeps research moving fast on large GPU fleets. ML Platform is organized into four teams. Depending on your background, you may join any of them. We're looking for strong distributed-systems and infrastructure engineers who want to sit next to research and ship platform primitives that move the product.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, and operate core platform systems used daily by ML researchers and product engineers

  • Partner closely with research to turn recurring pain into durable infrastructure

  • Own reliability, performance, and developer experience for the systems in your lane

  • Ship iteratively in a flat, high-ownership environment. Measure impact, then raise the bar

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in computer science, machine learning, or another quantitative discipline; OR equivalent work experience

  • 5+ years of industry experience working with production distributed systems (e.g., infrastructure, ingestion, data pipelines, or scheduling/orchestration, etc.)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience owning production distributed systems at meaningful scale (ingestion, data pipelines, scheduling/orchestration, or similar)

  • Experience partnering and building platforms for ML researchers and product engineers

  • Thrive where ownership is high and the feedback loop is short

  • Telemetry: event ingestion, product analytics pipelines, OpenTelemetry / tracing, reliable data APIs

  • Product Data Platform: data frameworks, Spark / Flink / Ray, ML dataset and training-data infrastructure

  • Observability: experiment / run monitoring, debug and eval tooling, agent-friendly observability UX

  • ML DevX and Systems: GPU / cluster scheduling, job queues, node health, research compute developer experience

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco, Palo Alto, and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries

  • If there appears to be a fit, we'll reach out to schedule 2-3 short technicals. After, we'll schedule an onsite in our office, where you'll work on a small project, discuss ideas, and meet the team

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$140,000 - $225,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

This is a builder-first role. SpaceXSI is building its first formal marketing operations function, and we're looking for a technical, hands-on leader to own the strategy side of it. You'll work directly with our Marketing executives as their operational right hand, turning a fast-growing marketing organization into one that's measurable, accountable and tightly tied to pipeline.

The foundation is already in place. Our core data model (campaigns, moments and leads flowing into MQLs for sales) is well built and working. Your job is to design everything that sits on top of it: how we attribute pipeline, how we structure and run campaigns, which metrics we report on, and how leads get to sales. You'll partner closely with our Revenue Operations systems team, who build and implement what you design.

Very little here is set in stone, so you'll have real ownership over how marketing operations works at SpaceXSI. Rev ops support is also expanding into other parts of the SpaceX business, which may open up a broader scope over time.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design and drive our multi-touch attribution model in your first 6 months. You'll define the methodology, get stakeholders aligned on the trade-offs, and partner with the systems team as they build it.

  • Redesign how campaigns are created, structured and managed in Salesforce so they're consistent, reportable and easy for the team to use.

  • Define the core marketing metrics, align marketing, sales and leadership on them, and track them consistently using dashboards and queries you build yourself in Databricks and Salesforce.

  • Own the marketing-to-sales handoff so MQLs reach sales and SDRs in a form that's easy to act on.

  • Launch and run a recurring pipeline council that reviews marketing performance, how it affects pipeline, and where to invest next.

  • Bring structure and clear ownership to marketing operations by setting priorities and preventing duplicated work, and partner with marketing leadership on planning, ROI tracking and spend decisions.


BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years of experience in marketing operations or revenue operations at SaaS or consumption-model companies, including experience leading the function

  • Experience running a pipeline council or similar review that ties marketing performance to pipeline and investment decisions

  • Hands-on technical skills, including writing SQL, building your own dashboards, and working with Salesforce data structures such as campaigns, campaign members and leads


PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience at both product-led growth (PLG) and sales-led growth (SLG) companies, with a clear sense of how marketing operations differs between them

  • Deep expertise in multi-touch attribution, including designing and owning a model end to end and explaining its trade-offs to stakeholders

  • Experience growing a marketing operations team, with clear ownership and priorities

  • Experience launching a marketing operations function from the ground up

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - WESTERN EUROPE

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

  • Own a portfolio of technology and ISV partners across recruit → onboard → activate → expand, going deep on the highest-impact relationships while keeping the broader set productive with programmatic coverage

  • Build joint plans with priority partners covering shared goals, listing and integration milestones, co-sell and co-market motions, and success metrics, and own outcomes including partner-sourced or influenced pipeline, marketplace activity, activation velocity, and partner health

  • Build and scale marketplace and ISV motions, including listing readiness, activation playbooks, engagement models or tiers, and field-ready co-sell and co-market plays, then prove new routes to market with a small partner set and turn what works into repeatable programs

  • Run the operating rhythm that still works when the book is large, including pipeline syncs, business reviews, executive check-ins, and escalations

  • Act as the primary internal owner for ISV and marketplace workstreams across Product, Eng, Sales, and Marketing, drive three-way coordination with AEs across SpaceXSI, partner, and customer, and bring structure through an operating model, scorecards, and rules of engagement as the portfolio grows

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 5+ years of professional experience in partnerships, business development, alliances, or channel roles; OR 9+ years of professional experience in partnerships, business development, alliances, or channel roles in lieu of a degree

  • 2+ years managing a portfolio of 10 or more technology or ISV partners at the same time

  • Experience launching or operating a technology partner, ISV, or marketplace program (e.g., partner onboarding, marketplace listings, or co-sell)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, FEDERAL SALES — DOW

As a Strategic Account Executive, Federal Sales at SpaceXSI, you'll own revenue growth across a named territory of Department of War and defense accounts. You'll partner with engineering leaders and development teams to bring AI-powered software development into mission-critical programs, helping the people who build the nation's defense systems ship faster and more securely. You'll be a foundational member of our federal sales team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a named book of DoW and defense accounts, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue against an annual quota

  • Build and progress self-sourced pipeline through outbound prospecting, account mapping, and partner and integrator relationships

  • Lead multi-threaded sales cycles across Engineering, Security, Procurement, Legal, and program leadership, from trial and technical evaluation through security review and large-scale rollout

  • Build ROI cases tied to developer productivity, AI adoption, mission outcomes, and secure software delivery

  • Navigate federal procurement, contract vehicles, and compliance requirements in partnership with Field Engineering and our AI Deployment team

  • Share actionable customer feedback on product, compliance, and deployment needs to influence the roadmap

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying enterprise or federal technology sales experience

  • Experience selling to Department of War or defense customers

  • Active TS/SCI security clearance

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, infrastructure, or cybersecurity products

  • Track record of closing new logos and expanding strategic accounts through self-sourced pipeline

  • Experience selling to technical and mission buyers, including engineering leaders, program managers, CISOs, and CIOs

  • Familiarity with federal contract vehicles, procurement processes, and security frameworks such as FedRAMP and DoD IL levels

  • Experience working with systems integrators and channel partners in the defense ecosystem

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

  • Based in, or able to work from, Sydney or Canberra.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, infrastructure, cybersecurity or emerging technologies.

  • A track record of landing new logos and expanding strategic accounts through self-sourced pipeline, including outbound prospecting, account mapping and partner-led sourcing.

  • Knowledge of Australian federal buying motions, procurement processes, security requirements and partner ecosystems.

  • Experience with AI or AI-powered developer tools.

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, ENTERPRISE - VICTORIA

As a Strategic Account Executive for Victoria, you'll be one of the foundational members of SpaceXSI's enterprise sales team in the region. You'll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of SpaceXSI, owning strategic accounts across Victoria and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders. This is a rare opportunity to bring a product engineers already love into some of ANZ's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across Victoria, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue; run a disciplined, full-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close

  • Build and execute account strategies that connect SpaceXSI's capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams

  • Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, and your own network; partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly

  • Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi-stakeholder approval cycles

  • Serve as the voice of Australian enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership

  • Help establish SpaceXSI's enterprise presence in Victoria by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references; consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering-led organizations

  • Experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in Victoria

  • Comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders

  • A true hunter: you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, executive engagement, and persistent follow-up

  • Strong command of pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting across a strategic book of business

  • Energized by technical products and can hold credible conversations with senior engineers, platform leaders, and CTOs about how SpaceXSI fits into modern development workflows

  • A self-starter who thrives in an early-stage, resource-constrained environment and can build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go

  • Care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

FIELD ENGINEER, PUBLIC SECTOR

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic customers across Public Sector. You'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI for the federal civilian and defense agencies modernizing how software gets written: helping developers, engineering leaders, and program teams evaluate our platform, running proofs of concept, and making sure they see the full value of agentic coding in their real workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering as a deal partner, not a demo resource.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with AEs to own technical discovery, demos, POCs, and technical validation for new deals and expansion

  • Build trusted relationships with engineering, security, product, and IT stakeholders across agencies

  • Work in mission-critical and high-security environments, including developer workflows, AI tooling, and complex or constrained setups

  • Help customers connect our platform to outcomes that matter, including developer productivity, secure software delivery, and mission velocity

  • Deliver technical presentations, whiteboards, and workshops for technical and executive audiences

  • Act as the customer's technical advocate with Product and Engineering, and partner with post-sales on clean handoffs and onboarding

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software

  • Experience supporting federal, defense, or highly regulated customers

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on software development experience and a working understanding of the SDLC

  • Daily use of AI coding tools and experience with constrained or air-gapped environments

  • Experience presenting technical concepts to CTOs, CISOs, and program leaders

  • Experience co-owning complex, multi-threaded deals with AEs

  • Familiarity with Public Sector buying motions, security expectations such as FedRAMP and DoD IL levels, and partner ecosystems

  • Active security clearance

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,500 - $224,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $235,000 - $320,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

  • Working in highly regulated industries, including guiding customers through security and compliance reviews

  • Hands-on experience with AI developer tools in complex or constrained environments

  • Presenting to technical and executive buyers, including CTOs, CISOs, and engineering leaders

  • Co-owning complex, multi-threaded enterprise deals with an Account Executive

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (United States)

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEERING - PUBLIC SECTOR

Our Forward Deployed Engineers (FDEs) don't advise from the sidelines. They embed with customer teams, build production-grade AI coding workflows alongside them, and leave behind habits that keep paying off after the engagement ends. As Regional Director, you'll lead and scale this team across our most important public sector customers, own engagements from technical discovery through delivery, and build the partner track that extends this work through GSIs and consulting firms. Success is measured by what's different in a customer's org at day 30, not by what got shipped.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and lead a team of FDEs in your region: hire, set clear technical performance standards and career paths, and coach the team on scoping and delivery of FDE engagements

  • Own scoping for PubSec FDE projects: run discovery and architecture reviews, surface integration and infrastructure constraints, and turn ambiguous customer problems into time-boxed proposals with clear ROI for six- and seven-figure engagements.

  • Hold the delivery quality bar across your team's engagements: tight scoping, milestone tracking, technical standards, and clean handoffs to customer engineering teams.

  • Serve as executive technical sponsor and primary customer point of contact on your region's highest-priority engagements, owning delivery and the relationship from IC engineers to the C-suite, and stepping in directly where the stakes are highest.

  • Generate a product feedback loop with Product and Engineering with enough detail to drive roadmap decisions, and turn what works into reusable solutions and product surface areas for all customers.

  • Contribute to the launch and scaling of the PubSec partner FDE track: train and enable GSI and consulting partners, and hold them to the same quality bar as the in-house team.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience directly managing a team of engineers who build and ship production software

  • Professional software development experience in Python, JavaScript, or TypeScript

  • Experience building and deploying AI-powered workflows in production environments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • U.S. citizenship required. Active security clearance (Public Trust, Secret, Top Secret, or TS/SCI) or ability to obtain one.

  • Leadership experience in forward deployed engineering, data science, machine learning engineering or software engineering

  • Debugging model failures in production AI systems

  • Scoping six- and seven-figure technical engagements with Sales and presenting them to C-suite and engineering leadership buyers

  • Enabling GSI or consulting partners to deliver technical engagements

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$350,000 - $400,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

You'll partner closely with customer engineering teams and internal stakeholders to drive complex deployments across engineering, security, IT, and executive stakeholders. You'll be responsible for ensuring customers achieve measurable outcomes while helping SpaceXSI scale its enterprise motion.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the success of our most strategic customer deployments, from initial planning through organization-wide rollout

  • Act as the quarterback across customer stakeholders and SpaceXSI teams, driving alignment, execution, and decision-making

  • Turn ambiguity into clear plans, identify risks before they become problems, and keep complex programs moving forward

  • Build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, executives, and technical teams at some of the world's most sophisticated companies

  • Create the playbooks, processes, and operating model for how SpaceXSI scales enterprise deployments

  • Bring customer feedback directly into Product and Engineering, helping shape the future of SpaceXSI

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience leading large, cross-functional technical projects with stakeholder complexity

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong customer-facing skills and a track record of building trust with senior technical and business leaders

  • Ability to understand technical systems and communicate effectively with engineers

  • Exceptional organizational, communication, and problem-solving skills

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and taking ownership without waiting for direction

  • Bias toward action and a willingness to dive in wherever needed to help customers succeed

  • Experience with enterprise software deployments, technical consulting, solutions architecture, or program management

  • Background working with developer tools, infrastructure, AI products, or technical platforms

  • Experience partnering with large engineering organizations and executive stakeholders

  • Previous experience at a high-growth startup

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $164,000 - $210,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PERFORMANCE MARKETING MANAGER

We're hiring a Performance Marketing Manager to help scale our growth engine. You'll build and optimize full-funnel campaigns across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms, turning paid media investment into qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue. This is a highly analytical, hands-on role with ownership spanning channel strategy, campaign execution, creative testing, landing-page experimentation, and measurement. You'll work closely with creative, content, product marketing, sales, lifecycle, data, and engineering to improve performance at every stage of the funnel, from the first impression through downstream conversion.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Paid acquisition: Own and scale paid acquisition across Google Ads, LinkedIn, Meta, Reddit, YouTube, and emerging developer-focused platforms; build and optimize full-funnel campaigns that drive qualified signups, pipeline, and revenue, not just clicks

  • Channel strategy: Develop channel strategy across search, paid social, retargeting, and experimentation budgets; manage campaign structure, keyword strategy, audience segmentation, and bidding to improve CAC and payback

  • Creative & landing pages: Test ad copy and creative angles tailored to technical audiences; partner closely with creative, content, and product marketing to ship high-performing ad concepts and landing page iterations

  • Measurement & reporting: Own measurement and attribution, with support from ops and engineering (tracking setup, conversion quality, offline conversion imports, and incrementality testing); analyze performance trends and communicate results clearly through dashboards, reporting, and weekly insights

  • Experimentation: Run structured experiments to identify new growth levers (new audiences, formats, offers, onboarding flows); stay current on platform changes, AI-driven campaign formats, and new opportunities in the paid media ecosystem

  • Downstream conversion: Collaborate with sales, lifecycle, and data teams to improve lead quality and conversion rates downstream

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience with Google Ads (Search, YouTube, Performance Max) and at least one major paid social platform

  • Experience in B2B paid media

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Track record of managing meaningful monthly budgets and scaling spend efficiently while maintaining performance

  • Experience managing paid media for a mobile app

  • Understanding of funnel metrics: CAC, LTV, payback period, and conversion rates

  • Experience with analytics and attribution tools

  • Analytical mindset with comfort in spreadsheets, cohort analysis, and performance modeling

  • Ability to move fast, test often, and iterate based on data and user insight

  • Comfort working cross-functionally in a high-ownership, fast-paced environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$180,000 - $220,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, GEO ENTERPRISE

As a Regional Director, Geo Enterprise at SpaceXSI, you'll build and lead a team of Account Executives driving revenue growth across new and existing business. You'll be a hands-on leader, coaching your team through complex sales cycles, building the processes and playbooks that scale our go-to-market motion, and serving as a senior voice for the enterprise customer inside SpaceXSI. This is an early and foundational sales leadership role. You'll help define what great enterprise sales looks like at SpaceXSI, working closely with GTM, Product, and Engineering to land and expand the Grok platform across the world's most sophisticated teams, based out of our downtown Austin office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire, develop, and coach a high-performing team of Enterprise Account Executives to meet and exceed revenue targets; build and execute a sales strategy, owning pipeline generation, forecast accuracy, and overall territory performance

  • Get into deals - support your team on complex, high-stakes opportunities by engaging directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, and other executive stakeholders across the region

  • Drive operational rigor: maintain accurate forecasting, pipeline inspection, and CRM hygiene across the team

  • Partner with Enablement to accelerate AE ramp time and build training programs tailored to SpaceXSI's enterprise sales motion

  • Work closely with Product and Field Engineering to shape how we position SpaceXSI to engineering organizations at scale

  • Gather and synthesize customer and market feedback to inform product direction and go-to-market strategy; build the playbooks, processes, and institutional knowledge that will scale the enterprise sales organization as we continue to grow

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of sales experience

  • 3+ years leading AE teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Track record leading high-performing AE teams

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, or emerging technologies to technical stakeholders, from ICs to CTOs

  • Are based in the Austin, Texas area and have an established network across the enterprise technology market

  • A track record of building teams from the ground up and developing AEs into top performers

  • A hands-on leader who stays close to deals. You coach through live opportunities, not just pipeline reviews

  • Strong operational discipline: you know how to run a forecast, inspect a pipeline, and build repeatable sales processes

  • Technically fluent enough to hold credible conversations with senior engineers and CTOs

  • Thrive in an early-stage environment and are excited to build the systems and culture of a sales organization, not just manage one

  • Help define what great enterprise sales looks like at SpaceXSI, working closely with GTM, Product, and Engineering to land and expand across the world's most sophisticated software teams

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the Austin office 5 days/week

DEAL DESK ANALYST - AMERICAS

We're scaling our Deal Desk function and looking for a high-ownership IC to join the Americas team. You'll sit at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, Product, and Business Operations, partnering closely with Americas sales leaders to structure and win the enterprise deals that form the backbone of our growth, and just as importantly, you'll help us systematize and scale how we get those deals done. We're in-person with cozy offices in North Beach, San Francisco and Manhattan, New York, complete with well-stocked libraries. This role requires five days a week in office.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Americas sales, legal, finance, and revenue operations to structure, negotiate, and close complex enterprise deals

  • Serve as a thought partner to sales reps on deal strategy: pricing, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, contract structure, executive engagement

  • Help evolve our pricing model and deal frameworks as the market and customer base shift, spotting trends across your deal flow, surfacing the patterns to finance and leadership, and driving the changes through

  • Lead cross-functional projects that systematize how we operate at scale, approval workflows, contracting playbooks, pricing guardrails, sales enablement materials, deal desk operating cadence

  • Improve the tools and processes we already have (Salesforce, Ironclad, our pricing infrastructure) by partnering with the GTM systems team, without needing to build them yourself

  • Balance a high-volume deal workload with longer-horizon strategic initiatives, managing competing priorities across multiple reps and deal cycles simultaneously

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience across consulting, investing, commercial strategy, deal desk, or a combination

  • Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, and direct experience with $1M+ ACV contracts

  • Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of scaling yourself, building processes, playbooks, and enablement so you're not the bottleneck

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Has operated at a level of owning outcomes, not just tasks

  • Highly analytical, comfortable analyzing pricing, building ROI models in Excel, and grounding strategic recommendations in data

  • A point of view. You don't wait to be told what to think, you come with a perspective and know how to back it up

  • Operate with urgency, ownership, and very little hand-holding

  • Based in or able to relocate to San Francisco or New York City

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

HEAD OF APJ FIELD MARKETING

As the Head of APJ Field Marketing, you are the chief marketing architect of our go-to-market engine across the Enterprise and Strategic teams. You will lead a high-performing team of Field Marketing Managers to design, execute, and optimize regional marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue. We are looking for a player-coach who is as comfortable interpreting a dashboard as they are commanding a room during a QBR. If you think business-first, are outcome-obsessed and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments, we want to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Architect the Theater Strategy: Develop comprehensive marketing plans across regions, segments, and industries to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts

  • Deliver theatre growth plans: Build differentiated strategies, scalable programs, and world-class events across buying personas and industries, delivering at-scale and account-based tactics. You also won't be afraid to jump in and execute alongside your team!

  • Galvanize Sales Partnerships: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales and Inside Sales Leadership through compelling executive presentations, insights-driven recommendations, and business reviews

  • Outcome Optimization: Track lead flow from initial touchpoint to closed-won revenue. Partner with Sales Ops to refine conversion metrics and maximize ROI

  • Lead a Remote Fleet: Manage and mentor a geographically dispersed team. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning

  • Drive cultural excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative execution across geographically distributed teams

  • Develop future leaders: Own talent strategy including succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development to build bench strength for sustained growth

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the "voice of the theater" back to Corporate Marketing to ensure regional needs are met and global initiatives are successfully localized

  • Establish executive-level reporting: Build comprehensive dashboards and KPI frameworks that track pipeline, program ROI, and business impact

  • Drive data-informed strategy: Leverage analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimize resource allocation, measure program effectiveness, and demonstrate marketing's contribution to revenue

  • Continuously optimize: Develop feedback loops and refinement processes that improve investment efficiency and program performance

  • Budget Ownership: Manage the APAC roll-up budget, ensuring every dollar is allocated toward high-impact activities

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience building and scaling marketing teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven people leader with a track record of building, scaling, and inspiring high-performing marketing teams

  • Coaching excellence: Demonstrated ability to develop talent, drive career growth, and create environments where top performers thrive

  • Change management prowess: Ability to lead organizational transformation, drive adoption of new processes, and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments

  • The Data Storyteller: You don't just report numbers; you provide insights. You are fluent in the metrics that drive the business

  • The Communicator: Exceptional presentation skills. You can build trust with C-suite executives and external partners alike

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to travel as needed to support theater events and team meetings

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, AI DEPLOYMENT

As Regional Director, AI Deployment at SpaceXSI, you'll lead and develop a team of AI Deployment Managers supporting some of our most strategic enterprise customers. This role exists to scale adoption quality and consistency as demand accelerates, translating SpaceXSI's momentum into repeatable, high-impact deployment outcomes while preserving the speed, flexibility, and developer-first ethos that make SpaceXSI successful. You'll own the post-sale experience for our enterprise segment, working closely with Sales and Field Engineering to ensure customers achieve measurable engineering and business value from SpaceXSI. This is a highly cross-functional role that sits at the intersection of customer success, technical depth, and strategic leadership.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Hire, lead, and develop a team of AI Deployment, including onboarding, coaching, performance management, and ongoing skill development

  • Own post-sale account planning, with accountability for account health, usage, risk mitigation, and expansion pipeline generation

  • Act as an escalation point for complex deployments and high-stakes enterprise accounts; build lightweight, scalable processes that codify what works while preserving speed, flexibility, and low friction

  • Guide best practices around rollout strategy, prompt design, context configuration, and internal enablement

  • Partner closely with Sales and Field Engineering to deliver a seamless post-sale experience and support expansion opportunities

  • Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Marketing to advocate for customer needs, influence roadmap priorities, and drive product adoption

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 4+ years of experience leading customer-facing technical teams in TAM, Solutions, Deployment, or similar roles

  • Experience owning post-sale retention or renewal outcomes for enterprise software or AI platform customers

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience managing ADM, TAM, or CSM teams for developer tools, DevOps, or AI/ML platforms

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles and enterprise AI: AI coding tools, AI agents, and LLM APIs

  • Experience presenting adoption and ROI results to VP Engineering, CTO, CIO, and line-of-business buyers

  • A high-agency, scrappy operator who thrives in fast-moving, ambiguous environments

  • Care deeply about AI and believe that transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $245,000 - $280,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

FIELD MARKETING MANAGER, HEALTHCARE / SLED

As our Field Marketing Manager for Healthcare / SLED, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for Healthcare and State, Local & Education (SLED), responsible for pulling together people and resources to build a full GTM marketing motion that lands and expands some of the company's largest, most critical named accounts in these verticals. This role sits in the Public Sector organization. You'll help support Public Sector overall, with a clear focus on Healthcare and SLED, and you'll collaborate across adjacent verticals where motions overlap (including Life Sciences events). We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with vertical sales and flawless execution of industry experiences for customer executives.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the Healthcare / SLED GTM: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan for Healthcare and SLED, and orchestrate core business partners into one motion aimed at must-win accounts

  • Master the Land & Expand: Own the vertical pipeline target. Design and run the programs that help priority accounts land, expand, and adopt more of the platform, focused where the commercial opportunity is highest

  • Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable in-person, virtual, and next-gen experiences, and the operational workflows that bring them to life

  • Industry Narrative: Translate the SpaceXSI mission into healthcare and SLED language, the problems these buyers already feel (clinical / payer / provider / state & education IT), the outcomes they are measured on, and why this platform is the answer. Partner with PMM and corporate marketing so the story stays sharp, consistent, and specific enough that a CIO, CMIO, or public-sector technology leader hears their world, not a generic AI pitch

  • Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Healthcare and SLED sales. Lead planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze vertical pipeline trends, lock alignment on priority accounts, and maximize the impact of every motion. Know what you run as Vertical vs what you plug into Enterprise Field formats. Support broader Public Sector needs as needed

  • Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program, ideation, promotion, vendor management, onsite, and follow-up, going beyond day-of execution

  • Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your vertical budget toward high-impact investments on critical accounts

  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the eyes and ears of Healthcare and SLED. Feed Corporate and PMM real-time feedback on messaging resonance and competitive shifts

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of healthcare marketing / GTM experience (provider, payer, health systems, health tech, or adjacent)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Healthcare Vertical Owner: assembles Sales, PMM, Enterprise Field, FE/Solutions, and CS/ADM into one motion aimed at pipeline on the company's largest accounts, not just events

  • Knows how to sell into healthcare buying centers and can partner credibly with sales on complex, regulated accounts

  • The Revenue Mindset: You care about pipeline and closed-won, not leads. You speak sales and will be held to a number

  • The Gritty Optimizer: A self-starter who can build a program from a blank page and tighten it with the data

  • Exceptional Communicator: Sharp and persuasive, whether it's a personal invite to a CIO / CMIO or a QBR for leadership

  • Event Craft: Experience producing high-end, white-glove executive experiences, including industry-flagship overlays (e.g. HIMSS / CHIME / HLTH-class motions) and 1:few vertical ABM, that stand out in a crowded market

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Field Presence: Ability to travel (~30%) to host industry programs, support Vertical Sales, and connect with customers in-market

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

$153,000 - $220,000 USD

You'll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of SpaceXSI, owning strategic accounts across APJ and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders. This is a rare opportunity to bring a product that engineers already love into some of Korea's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across Korea, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue; run a disciplined, full-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close

  • Build and execute account strategies that connect the Grok platform's capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams

  • Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, and your own network; partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly

  • Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi-stakeholder approval cycles

  • Serve as the voice of Korea's enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership

  • Help establish SpaceXSI's enterprise presence in Korea by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references; consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience

  • Fluent Korean

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering-led organizations

  • Experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in Korea

  • Comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders

  • A true hunter: you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, executive engagement, and persistent follow-up

  • Strong command of pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting across a strategic book of business

  • Energized by technical products and can hold credible conversations with senior engineers, platform leaders, and CTOs about how Grok fits into modern development workflows

  • A self-starter who thrives in an early-stage, resource-constrained environment and can build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go

  • Care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now
