SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

MANAGER, CHANNEL & PARTNERS

SpaceXSI is building its partner ecosystem across APJ, and this is a build-from-the-ground-up role at the centre of it. As the in-market partner builder for your market, you own the partner business end to end. You set the strategy, stand it up, and run it, all at the same time. You work as the business partner to the in-market Regional Vice President, turning their go-to-market priorities into partner-led pipeline and co-sell wins.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the in-market partner business from concept to completion. Set the market partner strategy and sequencing from greenfield, then execute it personally

  • Accelerate SpaceXSI's global partners into your market and incubate them to productivity, across Technology and Transformation partnerships; where gaps exist, recruit, onboard, and manage local partners from the ground up

  • Build and run co-sell motions, stand up FDE (forward deployed engineer) capacity, and drive C-level access and value-amplification programs through to landed wins

  • Turn partner relationships into qualified pipeline and closed co-sell revenue that feeds the in-market RVP number; build the data picture for your market and use it to drive decisions, priorities, and forecasting

  • Own the operating system that keeps it repeatable: reporting, tracking, tiering, onboarding flows, partner QBRs, and cadence; act as business partner to the in-market RVP, translating their go-to-market priorities into partner motion and giving them a clear, data-backed view of the business

  • Take ambiguous problems, from routes to market and contracting to partner economics, co-sell mechanics, channel conflict, localisation, FDE accreditation, and customer access, and drive them to a working outcome without the path laid out for you

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Fluent in Japanese

  • Professional working proficiency in English

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Deep understanding of the local technology and services partner ecosystem in Japan, especially SIs/GSIs

  • Will engage consistently with HQ and present plans to English-speaking stakeholders; fluency in both Japanese and English is the highest-value combination for this role

  • A builder-operator, a doer rather than a coordinator, energized by owning a business from greenfield and running it as it grows

  • Built and scaled technology, consulting, and GSI partnerships, ideally in enterprise software, and carried a number against that work

  • Fluent across partner business plans, program mechanics, enablement, and co-sell economics, and comfortable being accountable for the outcomes

  • Make decisions from data and can stand up the reporting and operating cadence yourself

  • Build durable relationships with partner principals and alliance leads, the kind of person partners choose to invest behind

  • Navigate negotiation and channel conflict with judgment, and you identify and influence the right internal and external people quickly

  • Operate credibly across diverse markets and decision-making styles, and you move fast

FIELD ENGINEER - SOUTH KOREA

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI in the field, helping customers evaluate SpaceXSI, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders.   • Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration

  • Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands-on workshops tailored to customer needs

  • Act as the customer's technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering

  • Collaborate with post-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively

  • Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Fluent Korean and business-level English

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs

  • A deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges

  • Hands-on technical ability, and while you don't need to be a full-time engineer, you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments

  • Customer-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (South Korea)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

About the role
We are looking for a Senior Motion Designer to help shape how SpaceXSI moves and shows up in the world. This role is built for someone who has built motion systems in fast-moving environments, cares deeply about craft, and brings an AI-first mindset to how creative work gets made. You'll join the Brand Studio, the team behind the brand across the entire SpaceXSI ecosystem (from Grok and Grok Bot to X), and help define both the motion language of the brand and how it comes to life in our campaigns and products.
This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you'll spend real time animating and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you'll lead projects from first concept through final delivery, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand moves.

What you'll do

  • Motion system: Define and extend the brand's motion language (timing, easing, transitions, logo animation, typography in motion, and graphic behaviors) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly.

  • Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring motion work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand motion without you in the room.

  • Campaigns: Concept and produce motion end to end, from storyboards through final delivery, across launch films, product videos, social, paid, web, and out-of-home.

  • Product motion: Partner with product designers and engineers to bring brand motion into product surfaces, from interactions and transitions to onboarding and launch moments.

  • Creative direction: Direct agencies, animators, and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you'd set yourself.

  • Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a motion point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders.

  • Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output.

What you bring

  • 6+ years of motion design experience, in-house or at an agency or studio.

  • Fluency in After Effects, Cinema 4D or Blender, Figma, and Adobe Creative Cloud.

  • Experience in AI coding tools, especially Cursor. You can build your own tools, scripts, prototypes, and simple web pages instead of waiting on engineering.

  • Hands-on experience with AI video and image generation tools as part of a real production workflow.

  • A reel and portfolio that show both motion system work and shipped campaigns. Bonus if they include tools or workflows you built.

  • Sharp instincts for timing, rhythm, typography in motion, and storytelling.

  • Experience in animation workflows from conceptualization, storyboard design, to execution

  • A systems mindset: you naturally turn one-off tasks into reusable processes and think about how creative work scales.

  • Conviction in your design decisions and the ability to explain why they matter, to designers, marketers, and leadership alike.

  • Self-directed, fast, and energized by variety and ambiguity.

Nice to have

  • Experience building or relaunching a brand's motion identity at a fast-growing tech company.

  • Experience with real-time or code-based motion, such as Rive, Lottie, or WebGL.

  • 3D modeling, lighting, and rendering skills.

  • Sound design sensibility, enough to work closely with audio partners.

  • Experience leading agencies on large, multi-channel campaigns.

This is a hands-on role. Much of the foundation is still being built, so you'll spend real time animating and making things yourself. It also comes with significant ownership: you'll lead projects from first concept through final delivery, and your work will help set the bar for how the brand moves. What you'll do - Motion system: Define and extend the brand's motion language (timing, easing, transitions, logo animation, typography in motion, and graphic behaviors) and document it so other teams can apply it correctly. - Workflows & toolkits: Turn recurring motion work into repeatable, AI-assisted workflows: templates, tools, and generators that let marketing, product, and other teams produce on-brand motion without you in the room. - Campaigns: Concept and produce motion end to end, from storyboards through final delivery, across launch films, product videos, social, paid, web, and out-of-home. - Product motion: Partner with product designers and engineers to bring brand motion into product surfaces, from interactions and transitions to onboarding and launch moments. - Creative direction: Direct agencies, animators, and freelancers with clear briefs and candid feedback so the output meets the bar you'd set yourself. - Collaboration: Partner with marketing, product, engineering, and leadership; bring a motion point of view to new surfaces as they appear, and present your thinking clearly to senior stakeholders. - Range at speed: Move between projects quickly while holding a consistently high bar, and keep improving the process, not just the output. SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CREATOR CAMPAIGN MANAGER

We're looking for a Creator Campaign Manager to join the SpaceXSI creator marketing team on-site in San Francisco. Our team leads creator and talent partnerships across the SpaceX product suite, running scaled programs across platforms, social channels, and content formats. This role owns creator campaigns end to end, from strategy and sourcing through negotiation, briefing, execution, and payment.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage multiple creator campaigns simultaneously, keeping deliverables, budgets, and timelines on track; develop campaigns across platforms and content formats based on each product's goals and audience

  • Source and evaluate creators based on audience, content quality, brand fit, and campaign objectives; lead negotiations on rates, deliverables, usage rights, and partnership terms

  • Manage contracting, approvals, invoicing, and creator payouts in partnership with legal, procurement, and finance

  • Translate complex product capabilities into clear, compelling creator briefs; review content and provide actionable feedback that maintains a high creative bar

  • Manage agency partners, holding them accountable for execution, quality, and results; build and maintain a high volume of direct creator relationships

  • Track campaign performance and apply learnings to future partnerships; support creator events and activations as needed

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of influencer marketing experience at a brand-facing agency or in-house on a brand's influencer marketing team

  • Strong command of the fundamentals: sourcing, negotiation, contracting, briefing, project management, and payments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience executing scaled programs with a high volume of concurrent partnerships

  • At least two years managing external partners, either overseeing agencies in-house or managing multiple brand accounts at an agency

  • Strong negotiation skills and confidence navigating creator and talent relationships

  • A high bar for creative taste and the ability to give clear, constructive feedback

  • Experience across multiple social platforms preferred, particularly Meta, TikTok, YouTube, and LinkedIn

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • This is an onsite role. Must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$180,000 - $200,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - JAPAN

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PRODUCT MARKETING MANAGER

We're looking for a Product Marketing Manager who can translate deeply technical products into clear, compelling stories that resonate with developers. This is a highly cross-functional, high-impact role. You'll work closely with product, engineering, and GTM to help define what we build and how we bring it to market. You won't just launch features, you'll influence product direction, define positioning, and help developers understand why SpaceXSI matters.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Product Launches: Own end-to-end go-to-market strategy for new features and major releases; write launch materials (blog posts, landing pages, demos, videos); partner with product and engineering to ensure strong product-market fit before launch

  • Positioning & Messaging: Develop clear, differentiated positioning for SpaceXSI and its features; turn complex AI + developer workflows into simple, compelling narratives; continuously refine messaging based on user feedback and market shifts

  • Developer-Focused Content: Partner closely with the Developer Relations team to create high-signal content for technical audiences (guides, use cases, comparisons); showcase real workflows and power-user behaviors, not generic marketing fluff; collaborate with the community to highlight authentic use cases

  • Go-To-Market Enablement: Translate product capabilities into clear, compelling messaging that sales and GTM teams can use effectively; provide the right narratives, positioning, and materials to communicate value and win users; partner closely with sales, field, and developer relations to understand customer needs and objections; continuously refine messaging based on real-world feedback and performance

  • Growth & Distribution: Identify and test new channels to reach developers (Twitter/X, GitHub, YouTube, etc.); work with growth to improve activation, onboarding, and retention messaging; run experiments to improve conversion across the funnel

  • Customer & Market Insight: Talk to users regularly to understand needs, objections, and mental models; analyze competitors and the evolving AI/dev tooling landscape; bring insights back into product and marketing decisions

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years in product marketing, product management, growth, consulting, banking or a similar role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ideally in developer tools or SaaS

  • A strong technical intuition, you don't need to be an engineer, but you should be comfortable understanding developer tools and communicating to a technical audience

  • Strong product instincts - ability to engage in product discussions and push back thoughtfully

  • Exceptional communication skills, and the ability to simplify complex concepts without dumbing them down

  • High ownership: you can take a project from idea → execution → iteration

  • Find comfort in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco or New York office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$153,000 - $205,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS STRATEGY & OPERATIONS MANAGER

We're hiring a Solutions Strategy & Operations Manager to help build the operating system for our Customer Success and Solutions teams, a role critical to building our business with rigor and pace and scaling customer value fast. You'll begin as a generalist supporting our Solutions Architect, Field Engineering, and Forward Deployed Engineering functions, with the path to own a specific business unit end to end as we grow and scale. There are early foundations in place, but much of the long-term system still needs to be built, from the key metrics that matter to the cadences that drive decisions and the playbooks that scale. You'll be a strategic thought partner and hands-on operator, equally comfortable thinking big-picture with senior leadership and getting into the weeds to build the systems, models, and processes that let the org run on real data.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Metrics & performance: Establish key metrics and compensation models; evaluate performance of the business, drivers, and trends, and guide targeted action plans

  • Planning models: Build, refine, and optimize headcount and capacity models to ensure we make the right investments; build segmentation and coverage models to deliver the right service model that ultimately leads to revenue growth

  • Customer frameworks: Build and operationalize frameworks such as health signals, customer maturity models, and corresponding playbooks that drive usage and growth

  • Dashboards & cadence: Build and operationalize dashboards that surface the right KPIs and insights at the right time to drive action across all levels of the organization; build an end-to-end operating cadence for the leadership team to support fast, informed decision-making

  • Leadership partnership: Serve as a trusted advisor to the leadership team, thinking big picture while leaning in to get things done iteratively

  • Cross-functional & global execution: Partner closely with RevOps, Go to Market, Finance, and more to bring concepts to life rapidly and iterate together; incorporate a global mindset, taking local nuances and input into account so global plans stick regionally

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Sales or Customer Strategy and Operations

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience with pre-sales (e.g. sales engineering), direct sales, and technical services teams

  • Builder mindset: comfort building from the ground up and flexing between launch-and-iterate and going deep

  • Analytical and modeling skills, with an operations eye for foundations such as capacity modeling, staffing, planning, and process

  • Stakeholder and project management skills: operating across levels and audiences, outlining what needs to happen, and keeping the team informed and engaged

  • Consulting, finance, and/or data science background, or customer-facing experience

  • Experience in Business Operations, Sales or Services strategy & ops, or company strategy such as localization and pricing

  • Experience with consumption-based pricing and with customer frameworks such as health scores and maturity models, with the open-mindedness to evolve them to meet our business needs

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco, New York, or Austin office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$250,000 - $300,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

INTEGRATED CAMPAIGNS MANAGER, AMER

SpaceXSI is hiring an Integrated Campaigns Manager focused on building demand generation and account-based marketing (ABM) programs to help us win and expand our most strategic accounts.

You'll help run the campaigns that create demand for our products among enterprise buyers building programs for priority accounts, crafting stories that land with our target audiences, and executing the webinars, offers, nurture, and campaign deliverables that turn engagement into pipeline.

This is an execution-heavy role with plenty of room to grow. You'll write the copy and execute the programs that carry each campaign, and bring a data-driven mindset to drive continuous optimization. It's a high-agency position for someone who loves to ship, wants to learn fast, and wants a direct line to revenue.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Build and run programs for priority accounts and segments.

  • Design and run ABM programs for clusters of strategic accounts grouped by vertical, tech stack, use case, or buying-group pattern, with messaging, content, and offers tailored to each cluster, in partnership with sales, SDRs, and field marketing.

  • Scale what works into 1:many programmatic plays across a broader target list of prospects and customers, using intent, enrichment, and ad targeting to reach the right buying groups without hand-building every touch.

  • Map buying centers inside each account (VP Eng, CTO, platform and developer experience leads, security and procurement) and build multithreaded plays that reach each of them.

  • Turn account intelligence, intent, and usage signals into tailored campaign treatments, from personalized outreach and executive programs to events, direct mail, and sales plays.

  • Tell stories that land with technical buyers.

  • Shape the narrative, messaging, and offers for each campaign, and write the copy that carries it: briefs, emails, landing pages, ads, and account-specific content.

  • Develop engaging concepts and formats for virtual events (webinars, workshops, and exec roundtables), owning all aspects of production from idea to follow-up: select relevant topics, line up speakers from internal leaders and our customers, and make sure everyone is prepared.

  • Brief design and creative partners clearly and keep the story consistent across every channel and touchpoint.

  • Conceptualize and deploy creative demand gen offers

  • Come up with offers that give target accounts a reason to engage, like meeting makers, direct mail, digital engagement programs, and gifting.

  • Work with sales and SDRs on who gets each offer and how they follow up, and manage vendors on fulfillment, shipping, and budget.

  • Track every offer from send to meeting to pipeline so we know what to repeat.

  • Build thoughtful email campaigns and nurture programs

  • Develop and improve nurture sequences for prospects and customers, segmented by persona, account tier, and where they are in the journey.

  • Write and edit email copy, analyze performance, and come up with new ideas for content angles and CTAs that improve engagement.

  • Partner with our lifecycle and email owners to keep lists clean, segments accurate, and every send on brand.

  • Execute the deliverables that bring campaigns to life.

  • Turn campaign plans into finished work: write briefs for design, and build landing pages, emails, ads, and sales one-pagers.

  • Own launch checklists and timelines, coordinate with design, web, ops, and sales, and ship on time.

  • Report on how each campaign performed, share what you learned with the team and sales, and suggest what to try next.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3 to 5 years in B2B marketing, demand generation, or marketing operations, with hands-on time supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for enterprise or technical audiences.

  • Hands-on experience supporting ABM or integrated campaigns for B2B enterprise or technical audiences

  • Experience writing and executing email nurture campaigns in a marketing automation platform

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • You're both left-brained and right-brained: as comfortable debating pipeline math as you are coming up with a creative campaign idea.

  • You write well. You can tell a compelling story, write copy that makes a busy engineering leader keep reading, and you have strong instincts for what good looks like.

  • You've supported ABM or integrated campaigns and understand the basics of account selection, buying groups, and multithreading in enterprise deals.

  • You're organized and detail-oriented, and you can juggle many deliverables and deadlines without dropping any.

  • You like working closely with sales, and you know how to earn trust with sellers.

  • You want ownership and high agency, and you'd rather ship and learn than wait for perfect information.

  • You can take a loose plan, bring structure to it, and get it shipped.

  • You're curious about AI and developer tools, and you use AI in your own workflow every day.

  • Hands-on experience running webinars, direct mail or meeting-maker programs, and email nurture.

  • Familiarity with tools like Salesforce, a marketing automation platform, webinar platforms, direct mail or gifting platforms, and Clay or ABM and intent platforms. Bonus if you've used AI coding tools to query data yourself.

  • Experience with verticalized or persona-specific go-to-market motions.

  • A track record of campaigns you can point to with real results, and the writing samples to back it up.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$144,000 - $176,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

LIFECYCLE GROWTH MANAGER

Lifecycle Growth's job is to get more people using Grok, Grok Bot, X, SpaceXSI and the API every day, and to turn that use into revenue. We own everything after signup: getting people to value, converting them to paid, growing their teams and keeping them coming back. We do it with lifecycle marketing, in-product messaging and a steady stream of experiments, and much of the work runs on agents we build ourselves.

This isn't a traditional marketing role. You'll do the work of a product manager, a product marketer and a marketing engineer, often in the same day. You'll own lifecycle growth for one or more of our products. You'll figure out where the biggest opportunity is, design the program, build it and show whether it actually moved the number.

The job spans consumer and business, self-serve and sales-led, so you'll need to think as clearly about a solo user's first week as about a team's path to an enterprise deal. You'll go deep on the systems underneath, like who's eligible, what triggers a message, how events and attributes are modeled, and how data moves from the warehouse into our messaging tools. When the best fix lives in the product or the data, you'll make the case and either build it yourself or work with engineering to ship it.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Strategy and roadmap: Own lifecycle end to end across our suite of products: Grok, Grok Build, Grok Bot, X and the API, from activation and conversion to paid through team expansion, retention and winback.

  • Data and audiences: Use SQL and product data to size opportunities, build the audiences and triggers behind each program, and prove what actually drove revenue.

  • Journeys: Architect multi-step, cross-channel programs across email, push and in-app, with event-based triggers, branching and suppression logic, and personalization drawn from product usage, plan and billing state, and company and role enrichment.

  • Systems: Drive and continuously improve the data model lifecycle runs on, including identity, events, attributes and eligibility, and partner with engineering on the warehouse syncs, APIs and webhooks that keep it accurate in real time.

  • Measurement: Run every program as an experiment with a proper holdout, measure incremental lift, and make judgment calls when a result is inconclusive.

  • Portfolio: Manage lifecycle as a portfolio of programs, putting more behind what works and retiring what doesn't.

  • In-product: Own in-product messaging and experiments, from onboarding and upgrade prompts to post-purchase plan tours, and partner with product and engineering to improve our in-app comms systems.

  • Tooling: Use code and agents to build the internal tools, templates and automated QA the team runs on, so each new program ships faster than the last.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years in Lifecycle, Growth PMM or Product Growth at a high-growth product company.

  • Hands-on experience running lifecycle programs in a major lifecycle platform, such as Braze, Customer.io or Iterable.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience running lifecycle for both consumers and businesses, self-serve and sales-led, with strong messaging craft. Experience running lifecycle at scale, across hundreds of millions of users and multiple products.

  • Real technical depth. You write SQL, you know how events, identity and attributes fit together, and you're comfortable with APIs, webhooks and warehouse syncs.

  • A history of building out multi-channel lifecycle systems with engineering across email, push and in-product messaging, not just running campaigns on top of them.

  • Programs you can point to that moved revenue, paid users or retention, backed by holdouts and judged on incrementality and lifetime value rather than opens and clicks.

  • Fluency with AI agents and code, using them to do far more than one person typically could.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

$216,000 - $297,000 USD

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

HEAD OF AMERICAS FIELD MARKETING

As the Head of Americas Field Marketing, you are the chief marketing architect of our go-to-market engine across the Enterprise and Vertical teams. You will lead a high-performing team of Field Marketing Managers to design, execute, and optimize regional marketing strategies that drive pipeline and revenue. We are looking for a player-coach who is as comfortable interpreting a dashboard as they are commanding a room during a QBR. If you think business-first, are outcome-obsessed and thrive in high-growth, fast-paced environments, we want to talk.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Architect the Theater Strategy: Develop comprehensive marketing plans across regions, segments, and industries to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts

  • Deliver theatre growth plans: Build differentiated strategies, scalable programs, and world-class events across buying personas and industries, delivering at-scale and account-based tactics. You also won't be afraid to jump in and execute alongside your team

  • Galvanize Sales Partnerships: Act as a trusted strategic advisor to Sales and Inside Sales Leadership through compelling executive presentations, insights-driven recommendations, and business reviews

  • Outcome Optimization: Track lead flow from initial touchpoint to closed-won revenue. Partner with Sales Ops to refine conversion metrics and maximize ROI

  • Lead a Remote Fleet: Manage and mentor a geographically dispersed team. You'll be responsible for hiring, onboarding, and fostering a culture of high performance and continuous learning

  • Drive cultural excellence: Foster a culture of innovation, accountability, data-driven decision-making, and collaborative execution across geographically distributed teams

  • Develop future leaders: Own talent strategy including succession planning, career pathing, and leadership development to build bench strength for sustained growth

  • Cross-Functional Advocacy: Serve as the "voice of the theater" back to Corporate Marketing to ensure regional needs are met and global initiatives are successfully localized

  • Establish executive-level reporting: Build comprehensive dashboards and KPI frameworks that track pipeline, program ROI, and business impact

  • Drive data-informed strategy: Leverage analytics to identify growth opportunities, optimize resource allocation, measure program effectiveness, and demonstrate marketing's contribution to revenue

  • Continuously optimize: Develop feedback loops and refinement processes that improve investment efficiency and program performance

  • Budget Ownership: Manage the Americas roll-up budget, ensuring every dollar is allocated toward high-impact activities

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership experience building and scaling marketing teams

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Proven people leader with a track record of building, scaling, and inspiring high-performing marketing teams

  • Coaching excellence: You have a demonstrated ability to develop talent, drive career growth, and create environments where top performers thrive

  • Change management prowess: You have the ability to lead organizational transformation, drive adoption of new processes, and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced, high-growth environments

  • The Data Storyteller: You don't just report numbers; you provide insights. You are fluent in the metrics that drive the business

  • The Communicator: You have exceptional presentation skills. You can build trust with C-suite executives and external partners alike

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Ability to travel as needed to support theater events and team meetings

ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, COMMERCIAL - ANZ

As a Commercial Account Executive at SpaceXSI, you'll drive revenue growth by building strategic relationships with customers and helping them realize the full potential of Grok Build for their development teams. You'll cover the full spectrum, from high-velocity, fast-growing startups to more complex Mid-Market deals, adapting your playbook to each.

You'll work closely with engineering organizations to understand their development workflows, demonstrate how Grok Build transforms developer productivity, and guide them through evaluation, implementation, and expansion. This role combines technical fluency with sales expertise to help companies reimagine how software gets built with AI.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the full sales cycle across ANZ, from first outreach to close, working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders; build and manage a healthy pipeline through outbound prospecting, inbound follow-up, partner referrals, creative sourcing, and your own network

  • Meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets; develop executive relationships and day-to-day champions within each account, becoming a trusted product expert for customers and prospects

  • Guide prospects through trials, technical evaluations, security reviews, procurement processes, and broader rollouts; quantify value with clear ROI cases tied to developer productivity, AI adoption, and software delivery velocity

  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies for the ANZ market; analyze market trends and translate high-level plans into targeted account activities and campaigns

  • Navigate complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, finance, procurement, and executive stakeholders; be the voice of ANZ customers internally, sharing actionable feedback that influences product roadmap, pricing, packaging, and go-to-market strategy

  • Help establish and refine SpaceXSI's enterprise motion in ANZ, including local market learnings, repeatable playbooks, and early customer references

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of closing experience in tech sales

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ideally selling developer tools, technical SaaS, or emerging technologies

  • A consistent track record of landing new logos and exceeding quota and managing a high velocity of deals

  • A true hunter - you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up, rather than relying on inbound demand

  • Comfortable navigating complex sales cycles and selling to technical stakeholders, from ICs to CTOs

  • An analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative, tactical follow-through to advance opportunities

  • A knack for bringing order to chaos and a genuine "roll up your sleeves" mentality

  • An excellent communicator who can present confidently and build trust across all levels of an organization

  • Passionate about AI and excited by the idea that transforming how software gets written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

  • A self-starter who thrives in an early-stage, fast-moving environment and can help build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

CUSTOMER SUCCESS STRATEGY & OPERATIONS MANAGER

We’re hiring a Customer Success Strategy & Operations Manager to help us deliver customer value and reach. We built our foundation around our coding product and engineering users. As we expand into general knowledge work and new use cases, our customer value delivery needs to evolve with it.

Our customers vary in type and size, and our goal is to unlock exceptional value for everyone. You’ll begin as a generalist across Customer Success, with a focus on solutions architecture, digital and scaled motions and the opportunity to develop deep expertise in a business unit end to end as we grow. You’ll partner with senior leaders to understand what’s working, what isn’t, and how to adapt the customer experience to drive value realization, retention, and growth.

You bring an analytical mindset and an orientation toward rapid experimentation. You’ll identify usage patterns that predict customer growth or churn, turn them into signals and plays the team can use, and help run experiments to learn what works so we can apply those learnings forward. The teams you will support are technical and experienced. They need a strategy and operations partner who brings insight and rigor that helps them make the right big bets and move with pace in bringing them to life.

You’ll be a thought partner to senior leadership and a hands-on operator who builds the models, insights and systems that help our teams stay agile and deliver on our goals. This isn’t a pure strategy role or a pure analyst role: you’ll set direction with leadership in one meeting and build the model behind it in the next.

Our organization is flat, and our team is small and talent-dense. You’ll have an outsized impact on our customers and the company’s trajectory. We’re looking for someone who is truth-seeking, collaborative, analytical, and loves to build.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design segmentation, coverage and capacity models so each customer gets the service model that drives growth and headcount goes where it has the most impact

  • Define the core Customer Success metrics and compensation models, and build the dashboards and tools that put the right KPIs in front of frontline teams and leadership

  • Analyze product usage to find the patterns that predict activation, expansion, retention and churn, then turn them into signals and plays the team can act on

  • Design and run rapid experiments with clear hypotheses and control groups, then scale what works and retire what doesn't

  • Build the leadership operating cadence, including business reviews, planning and decision forums, and track business performance so trends become specific actions with owners

  • Help build the scaled engagement model as one system that connects data, tooling, digital touchpoints and human coverage

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in revenue strategy and operations, customer strategy and operations, or business operations

  • Experience analyzing product usage data with SQL or a comparable analytics tool

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience supporting digital, scaled, self-serve, customer success or technical services teams

  • Experience building experimentation frameworks to measure the causal impact of customer programs

  • Experience building headcount, capacity, segmentation or coverage models

  • Experience designing customer health scores or maturity models

  • Experience partnering with Marketing and Product on lifecycle or in-product programs

  • Background in data science or analytics

  • Customer-facing experience

  • Experience with consumption-based pricing models

  • Experience building a strategy and operations function from the ground up

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$250,000 - $300,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SUPPORT OPERATIONS SYSTEMS LEAD

We're hiring a Support Operations Systems Lead to help own the systems, workflows, and operating rhythms that keep User Operations running reliably at scale. This is a hands-on technical support operations role for someone who can move fluidly between live triage of our projects, backlog management of internal requests, systems health, stakeholder communication, and end-to-end program ownership. You'll work across ticketing workflows, routing logic, queue health, labeling taxonomy, escalation paths, workforce signals, and internal tooling requests. The ideal person is more technical than a traditional operations lead, more hands-on than a traditional TPM, and less software-engineering-heavy than a dedicated SWE.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own day-to-day operations for core support systems, including ticketing workflows, routing, queues, labels, taxonomy, escalations, and related tooling; triage urgent operational issues as they arise, especially when system behavior, workforce distribution, queue health, or SLA risk looks off

  • Manage intake, prioritization, and follow-through for systems requests from support managers, TSEs, operations leads, engineering, product, and other internal teams

  • Help maintain the team's roadmap by distinguishing one-off fixes from broader system improvements, surfacing recurring pain points, and pushing back on low-leverage work

  • Drive smaller technical and operational programs end-to-end, being responsible for discovery, scoping and execution, rollout, documentation and success metrics

  • Partner with engineering, data, IT, and support leaders to debug issues, validate changes, improve monitoring, and prevent repeat failures

  • Use SpaceXSI and AI-native workflows to reduce manual toil, investigate issues, summarize signals, draft documentation, test changes, and improve how the team operates

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in support operations, systems operations, technical program management, or a similarly cross-functional technical systems role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience working with operational systems such as ticketing platforms, routing workflows, queue configuration, labels/taxonomies, dashboards, Slack workflows, and internal tools

  • Technical skills to investigate system issues, read configuration or code, and partner effectively with engineers

  • Excellent at triage and prioritization: when several things are broken or ambiguous, you can quickly determine what is urgent, what needs investigation, what needs escalation, and what should become a longer-term fix

  • Able to own work end to end: clarify the problem, align stakeholders, sequence the work, communicate tradeoffs, launch safely, and measure whether the change worked

  • Comfortable pushing back thoughtfully and can tell stakeholders "not yet," "not this way," or "this should be part of a broader fix" while maintaining trust

  • Energized by a role that blends firefighting with systems-building, and you have a strong bias toward action, clarity, and continuous improvement

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (United States)

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$118,000 - $145,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

AI DEPLOYMENT MANAGER - AUSTRALIA

As an AI Deployment Manager (ADM) at SpaceXSI, you'll own the post-sale journey for a portfolio of enterprise customers in Australia, driving adoption, retention, and expansion. You'll help engineering organizations successfully roll out SpaceXSI and evolve how they work with AI. You'll operate at the center of each account, partnering with developers, admins, and executives while working closely with Sales, Field Engineering, Product, and Support. You'll shape rollout strategy and influence SpaceXSI's roadmap priorities through customer insight.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Manage a book of business with our top enterprise customers, owning the long-term success of each account

  • Engage CTO / VP / SVP Engineering stakeholders to demonstrate ROI and guide AI-driven organizational change

  • Lead enterprise rollouts end-to-end: onboarding, enablement, internal champions, and scaled adoption

  • Turn high-impact use cases into durable, repeatable workflows across teams

  • Monitor account health and usage data to drive renewals and expansion with AEs

  • Represent the customer internally, synthesizing feedback and influencing product priorities

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

You'll go deep on a small set of strategic technology partners that matter most to how enterprises build with data and AI, and turn each one into a durable, multi-year relationship. As SpaceXSI's single owner for each partner, you'll own the executive relationship, joint strategy, product and integration alignment, and the co-sell and co-marketing motion that drives customer adoption and pipeline. This role is built for depth, not breadth, and sits at the center of how we work with Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing to make each partnership show up in real customer outcomes.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a small set of strategic technology partners end to end as SpaceXSI's single accountable owner, including executive relationships across alliance, product, engineering, and field leadership, and executive sponsorship on both sides

  • Build multi-year joint strategies and annual joint business plans (shared goals, integration milestones, GTM commitments, and success metrics), and deliver against partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, joint customer adoption, and partnership health

  • Align product and integration roadmaps with SpaceXSI Product and Engineering and each partner's product teams, maintain a current view of integration state and gaps, and bring partner and customer signal into SpaceXSI's roadmap

  • Build and run co-sell and co-marketing motions with partner field and marketing teams, including account mapping, joint account plans, field enablement, joint launches, customer stories, and presence at partners' flagship events

  • Run the operating rhythm for each partnership (joint business reviews, executive check-ins, pipeline syncs, and escalations), act as the primary internal owner across Product, Eng, Sales, Marketing, Legal, and Finance, and report partnership performance to SpaceXSI leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Bachelor's degree and 7+ years of professional experience in partnerships, alliances, or business development roles at a technology company; OR 11+ years of professional experience in partnerships, alliances, or business development roles at a technology company in lieu of a degree

  • 3+ years managing strategic partnerships with, or alliance programs at, data platform, cloud, or AI infrastructure companies

  • Experience owning a joint business plan with a strategic technology partner, including executive sponsor relationships and co-sell or co-marketing commitments

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on experience owning one or more strategic partnerships with a data platform, cloud, or AI infrastructure company end to end, including executive relationships and joint business planning

  • Track record building multi-year joint strategies with large technology partners and delivering against them across product, marketing, and sales workstreams

  • Experience aligning product and integration roadmaps with partner product and engineering teams, and launching integrations at partners' flagship events

  • Experience running co-sell and co-marketing motions with partner field and marketing teams that produced measurable pipeline and customer adoption

  • Strong cross-functional operating experience as the primary internal owner for a strategic partner across Product, Engineering, Sales, and Marketing, with executive presence with senior leaders at partners and internally

  • Partnerships experience at a developer tools, AI/ML, or data infrastructure company selling to engineering and data leaders, or prior experience at a leading data, cloud, or AI platform provider

  • Experience working within a major platform provider's technology partner program, including partner tiers, integration validation, and co-sell registration

  • Working knowledge of modern data and AI platform capabilities such as cloud data warehouses and lakehouses, data governance, and AI/ML services

  • Experience with AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud marketplaces and co-sell programs as they apply to data platform partnerships

  • Experience standing up a new strategic alliance from zero at an early-stage or high-growth company, tracking partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline in Salesforce, and using account-mapping tools such as Crossbeam

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to travel for partner executive meetings, joint business reviews, and partners' flagship conferences and events as needed

TECHNICAL SUPPORT ENGINEERING LEADER, SINGAPORE, AUSTRALIA, NEW ZEALAND, INDONESIA

We're hiring the first Technical Support Engineering leader in APAC to lead a team of Technical Support Engineers and deliver exceptional support experiences to SpaceXSI users. In this role, you'll guide the team in engaging directly with users, solving complex technical challenges, and leveraging learnings to build internal automations and optimize support processes. You'll be at the forefront of ensuring users successfully leverage SpaceXSI, shaping how AI-enhanced developer support operates at scale, and building the systems that make support world-class. Ideal candidates are former support engineers with proven leadership experience who thrive in fast-paced startup environments, are passionate about developer tools, and proactively enhance processes and automation while growing the people around them.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, mentor, and grow a team of Technical Support Engineers through coaching, feedback, and career development

  • Serve as the escalation point for complex or urgent customer issues, collaborating with engineering to drive resolution

  • Set and monitor team goals, metrics, and processes to ensure consistent, high-quality support

  • Partner with Product and Engineering to advocate for customer needs and influence roadmap priorities

  • Drive operational excellence by improving workflows, building automations, and streamlining tooling

  • Champion documentation and knowledge sharing to empower both customers and teammates

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience as a Technical Support Engineer or in a hands-on technical support role

  • Experience managing or leading a technical support team in a SaaS or developer-focused company

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a deep understanding of software development workflows

  • Familiarity with IDEs, LLMs, and AI-powered developer tools

  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to coach teams and engage with senior external stakeholders

  • Self-starter with curiosity, creativity, and a bias for action

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. SENIOR INTEGRATED CAMPAIGNS MANAGER, AMER

SpaceXSI is hiring a Senior Campaigns Manager to join our integrated campaigns team and help shape how SpaceXSI shows up to enterprise audiences. This is a full-time, in-office role based at our San Francisco headquarters. You will own high-priority campaigns that turn broad company priorities into focused, executable programs, working seamlessly across product marketing, sales, customer marketing, field, and leadership. The campaign strategies and programs you develop will shape our narrative in the market, create demand, generate & accelerate pipeline, and support customer growth.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Concept, develop, and run integrated campaigns end to end: Lead the strategy and audience selection through launch, optimization, and reporting; design the end-to-end campaign architecture, including the full-funnel content engine, channel strategies, promotional offers, program mix, and hand-offs from marketing to sales; translate company priorities into focused campaign plans with clear goals, messaging, milestones, owners, and success metrics; identify the highest-leverage assets needed to support campaign performance, including messaging frameworks, email nurtures, landing page copy, field activation ideas, customer story packaging, and sales-facing materials; bring multi-channel expertise to deliver campaigns via digital, web, email, online events, direct mail, social, events, sales plays, and more, all in partnership with functional and regional teams; strengthen cross-functional alignment, unifying all parts of the business around top go-to-market priorities; develop trusted relationships and facilitate integrated collaboration across product marketing, field marketing, performance marketing, growth marketing, strategic events, and design; work with creative partners to brief campaigns clearly and carry the message through across formats, channels, and moments in market; align closely with sales stakeholders to identify top priorities, build programs for strategic accounts, and ensure campaign initiatives are closely tied to revenue impact

  • Establish measurement frameworks, KPIs, and scaleable processes: Own campaign performance by measuring, analyzing, and reporting on the impact of campaigns on pipeline, revenue, target account penetration, and the demand funnel. Share learnings regularly to improve overall campaign efficacy; work closely with operations and analytics partners to define the right KPIs, shape useful dashboards and reporting, and surface actionable account or campaign insights to the business; help establish repeatable campaign systems, workflows, and handoffs that let the function scale without becoming fragmented

  • Adapt campaigns for SpaceXSI's most strategic accounts and business priorities: Build campaigns for enterprise and strategic audiences, including vertical, segment, buying-group, or use-case-specific motions. Translate vertical-specific messaging and proof points into campaign activations that make SpaceXSI feel relevant to the priorities of different enterprise audiences; build 1:few ABM motions & ABM-at-scale programs for priority accounts or segments, in partnership with sales and field teams

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 8+ years of experience owning integrated campaign strategy and execution for a B2B SaaS or enterprise technology company

  • Experience building integrated B2B campaigns across multiple channels (content, email, digital, field, and sales motions)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Knows how to connect content, email, digital, field, and sales motions into cohesive, high-impact motions

  • Know how to turn a campaign idea into a real operating plan, from narrative and audience strategy through asset development, launch, field enablement, lead follow-up, and reporting

  • Able to take complex, ambiguous problems and bring structure, clarity, and a clear recommendation

  • Comfortable being both strategic and hands-on, you can set direction, write a brief, shape the content, and help get the work shipped

  • Strong instincts for what makes a campaign cohesive across content, creative, distribution, and follow-up

  • Comfortable working across both global strategy and regional execution, and can adapt campaigns thoughtfully for different markets without losing the core narrative

  • Strong instincts for what makes enterprise campaigns resonate with senior technical and business buyers

  • Thrive in creative, fast-paced environments where original thinking and bias to action are celebrated

  • Able to shift between air cover demand generation and more targeted programs for strategic accounts, named accounts, and priority verticals

  • Balance thoughtful dedication to quality with a clear focus on impact and ability to execute with sharp, decisive speed

  • Extensive familiarity with lead-routing & handoff. You're able to diagnose funnel health and quickly course correct in tight alignment with your SDR counterparts

  • A proven track record of building campaigns for enterprise audiences, including technical decision-makers, executives, and complex buying groups

  • Owned pipeline goals in the past, and have experience using pipeline, engagement, and revenue signals to optimize campaign performance. You iterate continuously, quickly adapting to new signals, business priorities, and shifts in the market

  • Experience running ABM / strategic-account programs that support multithreading, expansion, or deal acceleration

  • A sharp understanding of the AI market and technical buyer personas (CTOs, CIOs, Senior Engineering leaders) to develop campaign activation plans

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$180,000 - $220,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

This is a proactive, sales-led role focused on unlocking the next wave of growth within some of SpaceXSI's most exciting customers.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a portfolio of existing commercial customers and be accountable for expansion, net revenue retention, and renewals, landing new business units, deepening adoption, and cross-selling SpaceXSI's platform

  • Proactively multi-thread into engineering, data, and product leadership to identify opportunities, position additional capabilities (agent-first workflows, new features, frontier models), and turn initial lands into multi-year, multi-product relationships

  • Monitor usage commitments closely and reach out long before customers exhaust their pre-commit to revisit value delivered, explain SpaceXSI's evolving product and model landscape, and right-size the next phase of usage and commercial structure

  • Run high-judgment renewal motions - from transactional, email-led renewals to complex, multi-stakeholder negotiations involving solutions, product, and leadership; help shape and execute an emerging tiering strategy across your book (Tier 1 strategic accounts vs. transactional tail) and ruthlessly prioritize your time accordingly

  • Stay on top of the fast-changing AI ecosystem - new models, pricing shifts, product capabilities - and translate that into clear, value-led narratives for customers; collaborate closely with Product, Support, RevOps, and Sales Leadership to tighten feedback loops from the field and level up how SpaceXSI sells and supports commercial customers

  • Target outcomes: You deliver meaningful value to customers, helping them stay ahead of the curve by growing adoption and transforming the way they build software; you consistently hit or exceed renewal and expansion targets across your book of business; your Tier 1 accounts see meaningful year-over-year growth in both usage and revenue, and you can point to specific multi-threaded plays you ran to make it happen; customers trust you as a strategic partner who can explain SpaceXSI's roadmap and pricing, and how the broader AI landscape is shifting and what that means for them; internally, Sales and Product leaders rely on you for signal on what's working (and what isn't) in our expansion and renewal playbook

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years of closing experience in tech sales

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Meaningful expansion and renewal experience: you've owned a book of business, run renewal cycles, and can walk through how you turned an initial land into significant expansion

  • Experience selling technical products, including dev tools, infrastructure, data/AI platforms, payments/fintech, or similarly complex, multi-stakeholder solutions

  • A strong commercial and strategic mindset: comfortable navigating change, usage-based models, and explaining "why things are changing" in a way that builds trust

  • Energized by change and ambiguity - the AI space is evolving quickly, SpaceXSI's product is evolving with it, and you see that as an opportunity, not a bug

  • A proven track record of outperformance (Presidents Club, top-quartile results, clear evidence you've been an outlier on your team)

  • Excellent communication and storytelling skills - both in explaining technical concepts simply and in running thoughtful, value-led commercial conversations

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the New York office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $90,000 - $120,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $150,000 - $200,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

REGIONAL DIRECTOR, FIELD ENGINEERING

We're hiring a Regional Director, Field Engineering to build and lead a high impact pre-sales Field Engineering team supporting our fastest growing enterprise accounts. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Product, and Engineering and is responsible for ensuring our technical pre-sales motion scales with quality, speed, and credibility. As the Regional Director, Field Engineering, you'll manage and develop Field Engineers who partner closely with AEs to run technical discovery, demos, and proofs of concept. You'll also stay close to customers and deals yourself, coaching in real time, unblocking complex evaluations, and ensuring SpaceXSI is positioned as the best AI-native development platform on the market.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead, coach, and scale a team of Field Engineers supporting enterprise opportunities; partner closely with Sales leadership and AEs to drive high quality technical discovery, demos, and POCs

  • Establish best practices for evaluations, proof-of-concept execution, and technical deal strategy

  • Serve as an escalation point for complex customer evaluations and high-stakes enterprise deals

  • Hire, onboard, and develop top-tier Field Engineering talent; set clear expectations and career paths

  • Act as the voice of the field internally, feeding customer and prospect insights back to Product and Engineering

  • Ensure tight handoffs with post-sales teams to support successful customer onboarding and adoption; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's product, roadmap, and competitive landscape

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 3+ years experience leading Field Engineers, Solutions Architects, or Pre-Sales teams in enterprise software

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Pre-sales leadership for AI/ML platforms, LLM APIs, developer tools, or cloud products sold to engineering, IT and business line leaders

  • Familiarity with software development lifecycles and enterprise AI: AI coding tools, AI agents, and LLM APIs

  • Proven ability to partner effectively with Sales while maintaining technical integrity and customer trust

  • Comfortable operating in customer-facing, high-pressure deal environments and guiding teams through complexity

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, and able to engage developers, architects, and CTOs

  • A builder mindset: you thrive in fast-moving, startup environments and enjoy creating structure where little exists

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Must be willing to travel to customer sites as needed

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $245,000 - $280,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.
