As an Account Executive, Geo Enterprise at SpaceXSI, you'll be responsible for driving revenue growth by bringing on new logos, building strategic relationships with customers, and helping engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of the Grok suite of products. This role combines technical fluency with sales expertise to help companies reimagine how they work in the age of AI. This is a rare opportunity to sell a product that is truly driving transformational change in how work gets done.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the full sales cycle from first outreach to close, working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, procurement, and other teams across the business at some of the world's most sophisticated companies

  • Build and manage a healthy pipeline, meeting and exceeding quarterly targets

  • Develop executive relationships and day-to-day champions within each account and become a trusted product expert; guide prospects through trials, evaluations, and rollouts

  • Quantify value with clear ROI cases tied to AI adoption and strategic initiatives

  • Design and execute innovative sales strategies; analyze market trends and translate high-level plans into targeted activities and campaigns

  • Be the voice of the customer and influence the roadmap with actionable feedback

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in tech sales with at least 1-3 years selling into Enterprise companies

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, or emerging technologies to technical stakeholders, from ICs to CTOs

  • Consistent track record of landing new logos, exceeding quota and managing a high velocity of deals

  • A true hunter, you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up, rather than relying on inbound demand

  • An analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative, tactical follow-through to advance opportunities

  • An excellent communicator who can present confidently and build trust across all levels of an organization

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the New York office 5 days/week

  • Be the voice of the customer and influence the roadmap with actionable feedback

  • Energized by agents as coworkers: you design how they work

  • Know how to manage accounts and relationships for outcomes: find whitespace, deepen adoption, and open growth paths

SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE - NEW YORK

As a Sales Development Representative at SpaceXSI, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast-moving startups to mid-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations. This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Cursor transforms developer productivity.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi-channel sequences

  • Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points

  • Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification, understand how development teams work, what's slowing them down, and where SpaceXSI fits

  • Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress

  • Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals; represent SpaceXSI's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company

  • Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing; help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of experience in a sales, customer-facing, or business development role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus

  • A relentless self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads

  • Write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience

  • Curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft

  • Organized and data-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly

  • Thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast

  • Want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the New York office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $70,000 - $84,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $100,000 - $120,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FIELD MARKETING MANAGER

As our founding Field Marketer, you will be the primary growth engine and lead marketing architect for the Japan region, responsible for translating our global strategy into localized, high-impact programs to both land and expand in the largest enterprise accounts. We are looking for a high-energy, revenue-minded marketing strategist who can alternate between strategic pipeline and account planning with the Sales Team and flawless execution of experiences for customer executives. If you are obsessed with driving pipeline impact from high-touch, standout programs and are a self-starter that thrives at the intersection of technical innovation and enterprise GTM, we want you!

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design the Regional Playbook: Build and execute a data-driven marketing plan tailored to your region's specific needs, focusing on the largest enterprise accounts

  • Master the Land & Expand: Own the regional pipeline target. You will deploy a mix of high-touch events, executive roundtables, thought leadership roadshows, industry tradeshows, and account-based activations to identify and accelerate opportunities that ensure wall-to-wall adoption in our highest potential accounts

  • Creative Agility: Fearlessly think outside the standard playbook to deploy memorable experiences across in person, virtual and next gen marketing formats as well as the operational workflows that bring them to life. Be ready and eager to break the mold and go big!

  • Big Picture Operator: Be excited to bring the SpaceXSI mission and story to our customers by partnering with corporate marketing to ensure sharp messaging at every touchpoint

  • Sales Partner: Act as the strategic marketing partner to Regional Sales Teams. You'll lead marketing planning calls, provide account-level insights, analyze regional pipeline trends, ensure absolute alignment on account priorities and maximize the adoption and impact of all marketing efforts

  • Event Orchestration: Obsess over the end-to-end details of every program with total ownership, from ideation, to promotion, to vendor management, to onsite experience, and follow-up, going beyond just day-of execution

  • Data-Driven Iteration: Track every dollar spent against pipeline generated. Manage your regional budget with a focus on high-impact investments

  • Feedback Loop: Serve as the "eyes and ears" of the field. Provide the Corporate Marketing teams with real-time feedback, needs and ideas on messaging resonance and competitive shifts

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of experience in Field or Revenue Marketing within B2B SaaS

  • Fluency in both English and Japanese

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Understand the complexity of selling to the CTO, VP of Engineering, and CISO

  • The Revenue Mindset: You don't care about "leads"; you care about pipeline and ARR. You speak the language of sales and aren't afraid to be held to a pipeline number

  • The "Gritty" Optimizer: You are a self-starter who can build a program from a blank sheet of paper and then obsessively optimize it based on the data

  • Whether it's writing a personalized invite to a CIO or presenting a quarterly business review (QBR) to leadership, your communication is sharp, professional, and persuasive

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Remote role (Japan)

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SALES DEVELOPMENT REPRESENTATIVE - SAN FRANCISCO

This isn't a role for someone who waits for leads to come in. You'll build pipeline from scratch, learn how great engineering teams think, and develop a deep understanding of how Grok Build transforms developer productivity. It's the fastest way to learn enterprise sales at one of the most exciting companies in AI. This role will be based in San Francisco.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Generate qualified pipeline for our Account Executive team through high-volume outbound prospecting, including cold calls, personalized emails, LinkedIn, and creative multi-channel sequences

  • Research target accounts and map stakeholders across Engineering, Product, and Leadership to identify the right entry points

  • Conduct discovery conversations that go beyond surface-level qualification, understand how teams work, what's slowing them down, and where SpaceXSI fits

  • Partner closely with AEs to develop account strategies, hand off opportunities cleanly, and stay looped in as deals progress

  • Hit and exceed weekly activity targets and monthly qualified meeting goals; represent SpaceXSI's brand and product with conviction; you'll be many prospects' first impression of the company

  • Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing; help build the playbook.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of experience in a sales, customer-facing, or business development role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company

  • Relentless self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads

  • Ability to explain a complex product simply and tailor your messaging across audiences

  • Organized and data-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly

  • Thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast

  • Desire to grow into an Account Executive role and drive to put in the reps to get there

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office 5 days/week

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $70,000 - $84,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $100,000 - $120,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - AUSTRALIA

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Willing to travel to customers

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

PARTNER ACCOUNT MANAGER - SINGAPORE

SpaceXSI is building its partner ecosystem across APJ, and this is a build-from-the-ground-up role at the centre of it. As the in-market partner builder for your market, you own the partner business end to end. You set the strategy, stand it up, and run it, all at the same time. You work as the business partner to the in-market Regional Vice President, turning their go-to-market priorities into partner-led pipeline and co-sell wins. Two engines drive the market, Technology partnerships and Transformation partnerships, both building on relationships SpaceXSI already holds.
Singapore is further progressed as a SpaceXSI operation, so this role is about acceleration: turning existing partner momentum into footprint, qualified pipeline, and co-sell wins faster than remote coverage allows.
This is a team of one in-market with a speed mandate. You report into the Director of Partnerships APJ, which keeps the craft and standards under partnerships without splitting your accountability to the market.
This is an in-market role. You will spend a significant share of your time in person with partner principals, delivery teams, and customers across your market, and you will work closely with a small, high-talent-density global partnerships team that values in-person collaboration and fast, direct communication.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own the in-market partner business from concept to completion. Set the market partner strategy and sequencing from greenfield, then execute it personally.

  • Accelerate SpaceXSI's global partners into your market and incubate them to productivity, across Technology and Transformation partnerships.

  • Where gaps exist, recruit, onboard, and manage local partners from the ground up.

  • Build and run co-sell motions, stand up FDE (forward deployed engineer) capacity, and drive C-level access and value-amplification programs through to landed wins.

  • Turn partner relationships into qualified pipeline and closed co-sell revenue that feeds the in-market RVP number.

  • Build the data picture for your market and use it to drive decisions, priorities, and forecasting.

  • Own the operating system that keeps it repeatable: reporting, tracking, tiering, onboarding flows, partner QBRs, and cadence.

  • Act as business partner to the in-market RVP, translating their go-to-market priorities into partner motion and giving them a clear, data-backed view of the business.

  • Take ambiguous problems, from routes to market and contracting to partner economics, co-sell mechanics, channel conflict, localisation, FDE accreditation, and customer access, and drive them to a working outcome without the path laid out for you.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • A bachelor's degree in business, engineering, computer science, or a related field.

  • 8+ years in partnerships, alliances, or channel roles in enterprise software, including carrying a partner-sourced revenue or pipeline number.

  • A proven record of building partner motions and co-sell in Singapore, with an established network across the local technology, GSI, and services ecosystem.

  • Based in Singapore and able to spend a lot of time in person with partners and customers, with professional working proficiency in English.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • A master's degree or MBA.

  • Experience standing up a partner business from scratch as a team of one.

  • Exposure to services-led or technical delivery partners, like forward deployed engineering or accreditation programs.

  • Experience handling channel conflict, partner contracting, and routes to market across several APJ countries, ideally with an additional regional language.

You'll be a foundational member of our Public Sector team.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a named book of SLED accounts, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue against an annual quota

  • Build and progress self-sourced pipeline through outbound prospecting, account mapping, and partner and reseller relationships

  • Lead multi-threaded sales cycles across IT, Engineering, Security, Procurement, and Legal, from trial and technical evaluation through security review and large-scale rollout

  • Build ROI cases tied to developer productivity, AI adoption, modernization, and secure software delivery

  • Navigate state and local procurement, cooperative contracts, and compliance requirements in partnership with Field Engineering and our AI Deployment team

  • Share actionable customer feedback on product, compliance, and deployment needs to influence the roadmap

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of quota-carrying technology sales experience selling to state, local, or education customers

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience selling developer tools, technical SaaS, infrastructure, or cybersecurity products

  • Track record of closing new logos and expanding strategic accounts through self-sourced pipeline

  • Experience selling to technical and executive buyers, including CIOs, CISOs, CTOs, and IT directors

  • Familiarity with SLED procurement, including RFPs, cooperative purchasing contracts such as NASPO, OMNIA Partners, and Sourcewell, and security frameworks such as StateRAMP

  • Experience working with resellers and channel partners in the SLED ecosystem

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, LIFE SCIENCES

You'll be a Strategic AE owning a focused set of Life Sciences accounts. You'll run end-to-end deals from first technical champion through security, vendor risk, procurement, and rollout, partnering closely with Solutions Engineering and Product to prove value in real workflows.

  • Land and expand: initial team → org standardization → multi-business-unit rollout

  • Feed customer signal back to Product/GTM and help refine repeatable playbooks

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years closing enterprise software deals with consistent quota attainment

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Experience selling into Life Sciences (or deeply regulated enterprise environments)

  • Comfortable with technical buyers and security stakeholders; you can earn engineering trust

  • A true hunter - you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up, rather than relying on inbound demand

  • A proven track record of outperformance (Presidents Club, top-quartile results, clear evidence you've been an outlier on your team)

  • Strong outbound + pipeline discipline; accurate forecasting and crisp written communication

  • Thrive as an IC in a flat org: high ownership, low ego, fast learning loop

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - INDIA

You embed directly with customer teams as the engineer on the ground: own an outcome, ship a production-grade SpaceXSI system that still runs after you leave, and become the critical technical feedback loop from the field back to product engineering. The work is the project. One week you might take a messy business workflow and put a production agent on it: pick the use case, stand up the architecture, wire it into the customer's auth, data, and tools, then harden it with evals until the team actually uses it. Another week you might live in a customer's repo and delivery system and ship an agent-powered path for a migration, a PR review loop, or an incident-to-fix flow, behind tests, review, and rollout rather than in a chat sidebar.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Lead discovery with the customer: orient in their codebases and workflows, find the real bottleneck and the use case worth building, and define clear success metrics

  • Design and ship production agents, AI applications, and coding-agent workflows on Grok and our models, on live business processes and inside the customer’s engineering org

  • Get a first version live in days, then harden it over weeks with rollout, monitoring, and iteration from real usage

  • Own production quality: tracing, evals, debugging model or delivery failures, and latency and cost tradeoffs

  • Build the systems around the model (tools, MCP servers, retrieval, rules, skills, CI gates, and evals) and integrate them into the customer’s auth, data, workflow, and delivery systems; decide when prompting, architecture, data, process, or a model change is the right lever

  • Measure the outcome that matters (revenue, cost, hours saved, error rate, cycle time, escaped defects), not seat adoption

  • Work directly with Staff+, platform, and domain leaders, going deep in their systems while communicating clearly about tradeoffs and results

  • Leave the customer team able to run what you built, and turn what you learn into reusable patterns and improvements to SpaceXSI products

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • You have 5+ years of experience in software engineering, machine learning engineering, or data science

  • You’ve owned a customer or operator outcome, not just a slide or a prototype, and can turn a fuzzy problem into a scoped, shipped system

  • You’ve built and owned AI-native workflows or agents in production (using Python, JavaScript/TypeScript), and debugged real production failures (model, tool, data, pipeline, or delivery path)

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • 2+ years in a customer-facing role, leading discovery conversations and being accountable for outcomes for external stakeholders

  • Hands-on depth in several of: agents and tool-calling, eval harnesses, retrieval and context systems, CI/CD or developer platforms, and AI-native coding workflows in a real repo

  • Experience as a forward-deployed, solutions, or platform engineer embedded with customers, or as a founding engineer who owned an AI product end to end

STRATEGIC ACCOUNT EXECUTIVE, FEDERAL SALES — CIVILIAN

As a Strategic Account Executive, Federal Sales at SpaceXSI, you'll drive revenue growth across a named territory of large federal accounts on our Public Sector team. You'll work closely with engineering organizations - from CTOs to individual development teams - to understand how they build software, demonstrate how SpaceXSI transforms developer productivity, and land and expand SpaceXSI across their organizations. This role requires deep technical fluency, the ability to navigate complex enterprise and government buying processes, and a genuine passion for AI-powered developer tools. You'll be a foundational member of our enterprise sales motion, based in the DC-metro area.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own a named book of federal accounts; drive new agency acquisition, expansion revenue, and long-term strategic growth; lead complex, multi-threaded sales cycles across Engineering, Product, Security, Procurement, Legal, and mission-critical stakeholders

  • Become a trusted product expert; guide federal prospects through trials, technical evaluations, security reviews, and large-scale rollouts

  • Build executive relationships and cultivate day-to-day champions across agencies, integrators, and technical teams; quantify value with clear ROI cases tied to developer productivity, AI adoption, mission outcomes, and secure software delivery

  • Be the voice of the federal customer and influence the roadmap with actionable feedback on product, compliance, deployment, and procurement needs

  • Partner closely with Field Engineering and our AI Deployment team to deliver outcomes from proof of concept through production deployment and expansion

  • Navigate federal procurement processes, contract vehicles, partners, and compliance requirements to accelerate adoption

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 5+ years of closing experience in enterprise or federal technology sales

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Ideally selling developer tools, technical SaaS, infrastructure, cybersecurity, or emerging technologies

  • A consistent track record of landing new logos, expanding strategic accounts, and exceeding quota through self-sourced pipeline generation

  • A true hunter, you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, account mapping, partner leverage, creative sourcing, and relentless follow-up

  • Comfortable navigating complex federal sales cycles and selling to technical and mission-oriented stakeholders, from engineers and program leaders to CISOs, CIOs, and senior executives

  • Understand, or are excited to learn, federal buying motions, procurement processes, security expectations, and partner ecosystems

  • An analytical approach to understanding customer needs combined with creative, tactical follow-through to advance opportunities

  • An excellent communicator who can build trust across all levels of an organization

  • Passionate about AI and excited by the idea that transforming how software gets written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The expected annual base salary range for this role is $175,000 - $200,000. This role is also eligible for sales commissions or bonuses, with an annual on-target earnings (OTE) range of $350,000 - $400,000. OTE includes base salary plus target incentive compensation, assuming 100% achievement of applicable performance targets. Actual incentive earnings depend on performance and the terms of the applicable plan.

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

As a Sales Development Representative at SpaceXSI, you'll be the tip of the spear for pipeline generation, the first voice a prospective customer hears, and the person who earns their attention before an Account Executive ever gets on a call. You'll work across the full range of our commercial segments, from fast-moving startups to mid-market engineering organizations, identifying the right buyers and creating the conditions for meaningful sales conversations.

  • Bring market intelligence back to the team: what resonates, what objections are coming up, what messaging is landing; help build the playbook. As an early SDR, your patterns and learnings will shape how this function scales

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 1+ years of experience in a sales, customer-facing, or business development role

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • SDR/BDR experience at a SaaS or developer tools company is a strong plus

  • A relentless self-starter who takes ownership of your pipeline and doesn't wait to be handed leads

  • Write and speak with clarity. You can explain a complex product simply and tailor your message to a technical audience

  • Curious about how software gets built and excited by the idea that AI is fundamentally changing the craft

  • Organized and data-driven: you track your activity, learn from your numbers, and iterate quickly

  • Thick skin and genuine resilience. You don't take rejection personally and you bounce back fast

  • Want to grow into an Account Executive role and are willing to put in the reps to get there

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

SOLUTIONS ARCHITECT - INDIA

We're hiring Solution Architects to help the world's best engineering organizations figure out what AI-native software development actually looks like in production. This is a deeply technical, post-sale role embedded inside SpaceXSI's most strategic enterprise accounts. You'll work directly with engineering teams to roll out high-impact workflows, accelerate adoption, and help organizations fundamentally rethink how software gets built with AI. Solution Architects sit at the center of long-term customer transformation.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Help Engineering Teams Adopt AI-Native Development: Roll out SpaceXSI across strategic engineering organizations; configure environments, design workflows, and run hands-on enablement sessions; help developers integrate SpaceXSI into real production workflows, not isolated demos; drive fast time-to-value and durable adoption across teams; identify workflow friction and solve problems quickly

  • Expand SpaceXSI Across the Organization: Identify where SpaceXSI should expand next inside the customer environment; help engineering organizations evolve from isolated usage to company-wide adoption; design rollout strategies for new workflows, teams, and platform groups; partner with customers to operationalize AI-assisted development at scale; work closely with Account Executives during major expansion moments

  • Become a Trusted Technical Partner: Build deep relationships with developers, platform teams, engineering leadership, and executive stakeholders; lead architecture reviews, technical working sessions, and strategic planning discussions; advise customers on developer productivity, workflow design, governance, and AI adoption strategy; coordinate across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Customer Success to unblock customer progress; help organizations navigate workflow and operational change as AI-native development evolves

  • Drive Real Customer Outcomes: Help customers translate adoption into measurable engineering impact; connect SpaceXSI usage to outcomes like faster iteration cycles, improved developer productivity, workflow efficiency, and engineering quality; help customers communicate the value of SpaceXSI internally and build momentum for broader adoption; turn successful deployments into repeatable workflow patterns across the organization

  • Help Make SpaceXSI Indispensable: Deepen workflow adoption and long-term product stickiness; monitor competitive risk and help customers standardize on SpaceXSI over time; support recovery plans when adoption slows or competing tools gain traction; help customers build workflows they can't imagine operating without

  • Shape the Future of the Product: Bring structured feedback from strategic customers into Product and Engineering; identify emerging workflow patterns, friction points, and enterprise requirements; help shape new capabilities through lighthouse customers and design partnerships; turn successful customer workflows into reusable playbooks and reference patterns

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Technical background in software engineering, infrastructure, DevOps, platform engineering, or developer tooling

  • Experience in a customer-facing technical role such as Solutions Architect, Solutions Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineer, Technical Account Manager, Enterprise Architect, or similar

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • The ability to work hands-on with engineering teams while also operating strategically with technical leadership

  • A strong understanding of developer workflows, SDLC tooling, integrations, CI/CD systems, governance, and enterprise engineering environments

  • Excellent communication skills and the ability to explain complex technical concepts clearly across both technical and executive audiences

  • Strong instincts around workflow design, adoption strategy, and driving workflow change across engineering teams

  • High ownership, strong execution skills, and comfort operating in fast-moving environments with ambiguity

  • A passion for developer tooling and strong conviction around how AI will reshape software engineering

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Willing to travel to customers

DEAL DESK MANAGER, APJ

We're building out our Deal Desk function in APJ and looking for a high-ownership Deal Desk Manager to be one of our first people on the ground in the region. This is a hands-on individual-contributor role, sitting at the intersection of Sales, Legal, Finance, and Revenue Operations, partnering with our APJ sales team to structure, price, and close enterprise deals, and giving the region the fast, in-time-zone deal support it needs as it scales. You'll be one of the first Deal Desk hires in APJ, working closely with the global Deal Desk team while becoming the go-to deal partner for reps across the region. The function is established globally and humming with volume. Your job is to bring that same discipline to APJ and own deal support end-to-end for the region.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Own day-to-day deal desk support for the APJ sales team, pricing, deal structure, quoting, and approvals, in-region and in-time-zone

  • Serve as a strategic thought partner to reps on deal strategy: pricing guidance, competitive positioning, negotiation approach, and contract structure

  • Build and manage quotes and order forms in Salesforce CPQ / Ironclad, and keep deals moving cleanly through the approval and closing process

  • Coordinate cross-functionally with Legal, Finance, and Billing to get non-standard terms reviewed and closed without slowing deals down

  • Stand up and scale APJ deal desk processes, turning recurring rep questions and one-off asks into repeatable playbooks, approval paths, and enablement

  • Apply and help evolve our consumption-based pricing model, surfacing patterns from APJ deal flow back to the global team

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • 7+ years of experience across deal desk, deal/revenue operations, commercial strategy, consulting, investing, or sales strategy

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Has owned outcomes, not just tasks

  • Experience working on enterprise B2B deals, ideally in SaaS or infrastructure, with hands-on exposure to pricing, negotiation, and contract structure

  • Experience operating in a high-volume deal environment and a track record of systematizing how you work, playbooks, processes, approval frameworks

  • Highly analytical, comfortable sizing deals, modeling pricing scenarios and ROI in Excel, and grounding recommendations in data

FIELD ENGINEER - INDIA

We're hiring Field Engineers to partner with prospective and strategic enterprise customers. As a Field Engineer, you'll be the technical face of SpaceXSI in the field, helping customers evaluate SpaceXSI, guiding them through proofs of concept, and ensuring they see the full value of AI in their engineering workflows. You'll work hand-in-hand with Sales, Product, and Engineering to scope solutions, demonstrate capabilities, and act as a trusted advisor to technical stakeholders. This is a highly customer-facing role where you'll combine deep technical fluency with strong communication skills to drive adoption and influence product direction.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Partner with Account Executives to lead technical discovery, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements; build trusted relationships with engineering leaders, architects, and developers, serving as their technical advisor

  • Translate customer requirements into solution designs, guiding them on best practices for rollout, prompt strategy, and context configuration

  • Develop and deliver technical presentations, whiteboard sessions, and hands-on workshops tailored to customer needs

  • Act as the customer's technical advocate internally, influencing roadmap priorities and escalating feedback to Product and Engineering

  • Collaborate with post-sales teams to ensure a smooth handoff and successful customer onboarding; maintain deep knowledge of SpaceXSI's capabilities and competitive landscape to position our value effectively

  • Support strategic account planning and help drive expansion opportunities with technical validation

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience in Field Engineering, Solutions Architecture, Pre-Sales, or Consulting for enterprise software

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Strong communication skills and executive presence, equally comfortable coding alongside developers or presenting to CTOs

  • A deep understanding of the software development lifecycle, modern engineering org structures, and developer productivity challenges

  • Hands-on technical ability, and while you don't need to be a full-time engineer, you should be fluent in technical workflows, AI tooling, and debugging complex environments

  • Customer-obsessed with a knack for translating technical details into business impact

  • Thrive in a startup environment: resourceful, adaptable, and proactive in creating solutions

SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today, SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of making life multiplanetary and expanding consciousness to the stars.

SpaceXSI is building Super Intelligence to help humanity understand the universe. Our teams are building the full Super Intelligence stack: from our Colossus supercomputers, to Grok models, to our suite of applications, including Grok Bot, Grok Build, Grok Imagine, Grok Voice, and X. We're creating a powerful flywheel where more compute trains better models, better models power more useful products, and what we learn from people using those products shapes what we build next.

BRAND PAID MEDIA MANAGER

We're looking for a Brand Paid Media Manager to build awareness, shape perception, and introduce our brand to new audiences at scale. You'll lead top-of-funnel media across channels such as television, podcasts, out-of-home, streaming audio and video, and other high-impact brand placements. This role blends strategic thinking with hands-on execution. You'll determine where and how we show up, negotiate and manage media investments, and partner with creative and brand teams to develop campaigns that resonate with technical and business audiences.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Develop and execute a top-of-funnel paid media strategy across television, podcasts, out-of-home, streaming, audio, video, sponsorships, and emerging channels; own media planning, budgeting, forecasting, and allocation across brand campaigns; identify the markets, audiences, programs, creators, and cultural moments where our brand can have the greatest impact

  • Manage relationships with media agencies, networks, publishers, podcast partners, and other vendors; lead media buying and negotiations, securing effective placements, pricing, added value, and contract terms

  • Partner closely with brand, creative, content, communications, and product marketing teams to develop memorable campaign concepts; translate campaign strategy into clear creative briefs, channel plans, audience recommendations, and production requirements

  • Ensure creative is tailored to each medium while maintaining a consistent brand narrative; build testing plans across markets, audiences, messages, formats, frequency, and media mix; establish measurement frameworks for brand awareness, consideration, reach, frequency, share of voice, branded search, direct traffic, and downstream demand

  • Use brand-lift studies, geographic testing, incrementality analysis, and other methods to evaluate campaign impact; monitor campaigns, surface insights, and adjust investment based on performance, audience response, and business priorities

  • Communicate campaign plans, results, and recommendations clearly to cross-functional partners and company leadership; stay current on shifts in media consumption, advertising technology, measurement, and emerging brand opportunities

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Hands-on experience in paid media, with a focus on brand advertising, media planning, and buying across top-of-funnel channels.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Hands-on experience planning, buying, and optimizing brand campaigns across channels such as TV, connected TV (CTV), podcasts, out-of-home (OOH), streaming audio, and digital video.

  • Proven ability to manage large media budgets, develop media plans, allocate investments, and negotiate directly with publishers, networks, and media partners.

  • Strong understanding of media planning fundamentals, including reach, frequency, audience targeting, market selection, and cross-channel media mix.

  • Experience measuring brand advertising effectiveness through brand-lift studies, incrementality testing, media mix modeling (MMM), geographic experiments, and other analytical approaches.

  • Strong creative instincts and experience collaborating with brand, creative, and marketing teams to develop campaigns that resonate with target audiences.

  • Highly analytical, organized, and comfortable owning campaigns end-to-end, from strategy and execution through measurement, optimization, and communicating results to leadership.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • The ability to work in person from our San Francisco office

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

The annual compensation range for this role is listed below.

Annual Salary:

$180,000 - $220,000 USD

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of our total rewards package at SpaceXSI, which also includes equity, comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short & long-term disability insurance, life insurance, and various other discounts and perks.

COMMUNITY OPERATIONS LEAD

In this role, you'll build the infrastructure and manage the daily operations behind SpaceXSI's global community programs. You'll architect internal tools and automate workflows across our community initiatives, using the latest development tools to help the team work more efficiently. This role will be pivotal in giving our community team the backbone it needs to scale significantly in 2027.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Design, build, and maintain internal tooling and infrastructure that makes our global community programs run more effectively, including our Ambassador programs, student programs, and net-new programs

  • Identify operational gaps and engineer solutions: automate manual processes, integrate external platforms, and build custom workflows from scratch

  • Own the operational experience behind programs, including application reviews, onboarding, member support, reimbursements, swag logistics, vendor coordination, and event operations

  • Work with the Revenue Operations team to build the data infrastructure and dashboards behind community reporting, connecting program data to company-wide tools to track ROI and conversions

  • Serve as the main operational point of contact for ambassadors and internal partners, speeding up resolution of outstanding issues and questions

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Experience building databases, workflows, and automations

  • Experience managing vendors, budgets, and event operations globally

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

  • Operations systems designed to scale for the next 10x, not just today

  • Familiarity with the realities of global operations: time zones, currencies, international shipping, and local regulations

  • Bias toward action: shipping an 80% solution today rather than waiting for perfect, and making an impact on day one

  • Care for community and an understanding of the importance of building strong relationships with our champions

  • Comfort with ambiguity and energy for greenfield problems as an early hire on a rapidly growing team

  • Fluency with Cursor, Databricks, Luma, Slack, Notion, Salesforce, CRM, and Clay

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

  • Onsite role: must be able to work in person at the San Francisco office
